column3: babhāse sā sabhā vīrair dyaur ivāmaraśekharaiḥ ||
ko hi hastāvaceyeṣu padmeṣu paraśuṃ kṣipet ||
tadeva matamasmākaṃ kva vinā sāma siddhayaḥ ||
rūḍhasnehāḥ parārtheṣu na te śāmyanti kauravāḥ |
hariryadāha rāmaśca sa evādya satāṃ kramaḥ |
sātyakiḥ śauryasadṛśaṃ dhanyaṃ kiṃ vā prabhāṣatām ||
rājñā dūtā visṛjyantāṃ kṛtakaṃ sāma cārthyatām |
ityuktvā drupado rājā virarāma dhiyā nidhiḥ |
vaktuṃ tvameva jānīṣe vicitraṃ laghu sāravat |
atṛptā darśane tasya pārthāḥ saṃstambhya mānasam |
jagmatuḥ keśavaṃ tulyaṃ sāhāyyaṃ yācituṃ raṇe ||
purā triśirasaṃ śakraḥ sutaṃ tvaṣṭuḥ prajāpateḥ |
tapasā yena vijitāḥ surāḥ śarma na lebhire ||
sāmnā sakhyaṃ samādāya sa vṛtreṇa tarasvinā |
sā satī balinā tena yācyamānā punaḥ punaḥ |
guruṃ bṛhaspatiṃ patyuḥ prayayau śaraṇaṃ śacī ||
gatvā tvaṃ yuktimāsthāya brūhi taṃ manmathāntaram |
tannāma viditaṃ loke yathā cātmā tathātmajaḥ ||
bhavadbhiḥ svecchayā dattāmapi pārthaḥ kṛśāṃ śriyam |
yathāsya sā hṛtā naiva tadvaktuṃ matameti naḥ |
iti yaudhiṣṭhiraṃ vipraḥ saṃdeśaṃ vinivedya saḥ |
diṣṭyā śamārthinaḥ pārthā diṣṭyā necchanti saṃgaram ||
aho nu vallabho mantrī hitamābhāṣase prabhoḥ ||
na śaktāḥ samare sthātuṃ na cecchanti śamaṃ khalāḥ |
amīṣāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ kṛtsnasya ca kulasya naḥ |
api vīkṣya na tādṛśi vetyāyūṃṣi vahantyasau ||
athavā manyunā vyāpto vartase yadi niṣkṛpaḥ |
yadi dharmaḥ pramāṇaṃ te na syātsaralacetasaḥ |
sarvakṣayaphale yuddhe vibhūtyai mā kṛthā matim |
iti śaurervacaḥ śrutvā sānujasya ca bhūpateḥ |

column9: sa gatvā hāstinapuraṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ sametya ca |

column3: jāne naitadvacaḥ prātaḥ sabhāyāṃ kiṃ nu vakṣyati ||
cintājvareṇa spṛśyante na hi nāma manīṣiṇaḥ ||
vikāro lakṣyate yena na saṃpatsu vipaścitā |
na duḥkhito .pi saṃtāpaṃ bhajate yaḥ sa paṇḍitaḥ ||
anindyaṃ kurute yaśca sa vidvāniti gaṇyate ||
āyāso jīvitaṃ yeṣāṃ nidhanaṃ ca priyāśiṣaḥ ||
vṛddhiṃ yadyāti sahasā mūḍhānāṃ viddhi tadgatam |
vayaṃ śreṣṭhā iti mitho vivādaḥ samajāyata ||
vāṇī ca satyābharaṇā na hi nāmākṛtātmanām ||
na giro marmabhedinyaḥ sabhrūbhaṅgāśca no dṛśaḥ |
na sevyā dhanino nīcā nānugamyā madoddhatāḥ |
na kāryāḥ suhṛdo lubdhā nākṣepyā balaśālinaḥ ||
anāgateṣu doṣeṣu yo na jānāti saṃvṛtim |
vyasane saṃnipatito vivaśaḥ sa karoti kim ||
jayaṃ dharmānujaṃ jāne kiṃtu tyājyo na me sutaḥ ||
purā na mṛtyurastīti śrutaṃ gūḍhaṃ vaco mayā |
kathaṃ tadapi me kṣattaḥ saṃśayaṃ chettumarhati ||
krodho .ntakaḥ sarvamidaṃ nihanti ya eṣa puṃsāṃ vadanādudeti |
vimohakāmāñjalinā janaughaṃ pibannaśeṣaṃ maraṇaṃ na mṛtyuḥ ||
janmaiva mṛtyuḥ sa yato .sti tasmiñjanmanyapete na hi mṛtyurasti ||
jayanti viprā maraṇaṃ na nāma śuṣkakriyāmātraniṣaṇṇacittāḥ |
chandāṃsi tatraiva nivārayanti na tīrthasevā na tapo na yajñaḥ ||
kāmo vivitsā ca vimohayuktā doṣā nṛṇāṃ dvādaśaghoramṛtyuḥ ||
yacchukrato brahmamahatprakāśaṃ yāte mṛte dyaur vidiśo diśaśca |
yat prāṇito rājati khe vivasvānsanātano yogivaraiḥ sa mṛgyaḥ ||
janmanyudaste yadupaiti mṛtyuḥ pṛṣṭe ca śukroccaritaḥ prakāśe |
pratyāgataḥ pāṇḍavebhyaḥ kiṃ nu vakṣyati saṃjayaḥ |
pūrvaṃ gāvalgane brūhi kimāha sa dhanaṃjayaḥ |
śrūyatāṃ suhṛdāṃ madhye kirīṭī māṃ yadabhyadhāt ||
sthāsyanti te kathaṃ nāma yeṣāṃ yuddhamupasthitam |
drakṣyanti me rathe dṛptaṃ kuravaḥ kapikuñjaram |
ghoraḥ kahakahaḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate yasya garjitaḥ |
haniṣyāmi raṇe pārthāngiraṃ karṇo bravīti yat |
dṛṣṭaṃ taddhopayātrāyāṃ gograhe ca svayaṃ tvayā ||
kiṃ kurmaḥ samarārambho na syādyadi mahīpateḥ |
yadā tvayā virahitaṃ sainyaṃ rājño bhaviṣyati |
yoddhārastatra ke prāptāḥ kiyacca vipulaṃ balam |
vīro yuddhaṃ ca yenāsya vipulo balasaṃgrahaḥ ||
bhuvi santi gajā naiva hayāśca vanakuñjarāḥ |
paśyāmīva punaḥ prāptaṃ putrāṇāṃ nidhanaṃ raṇe ||
hatā api na śakṣyanti manye gantuṃ divaṃ nṛpāḥ ||
gajastho bhagadatto vā tulyaṃ manye raṇe na vā ||
yeṣāṃ śāntanavo goptā droṇaśca sasuto yudhi |
teṣāṃ śaṅkāspadaṃ sākṣādapi manye na vajrabhṛt ||
saha jālena patitau gṛhītau tena dhīmatā ||
putra dattvā nijaṃ rājyaṃ pārthebhyo rakṣa jīvitam |
kimanyatra śṛṇoṣi tvaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ śṛṇotu te |
dāne viṣayabhoge ca dhanahīnaḥ karoti kim ||
kathaṃ nu kṣatriyo bhūtvā rājyaṃ nijabhujārjitam |
iti dattaṃ kṛpāviṣṭairbhuñjate na hi māninaḥ ||
ekaṃ cānyamapi jñātaṃ grāmānpañca dadātu naḥ ||
jāne mama vaco rājā kuruvṛddhaḥ kariṣyati ||
gamanaṃ tatra te kṛṣṇa na mahyamabhirocate ||
mā kṛthāḥ saṃśayaṃ rājanmayi nāsau pragalbhate ||
gamyatāṃ tatra kuntī tu samāśvāsyā tvayā prabho |
kṛṣṇāṃ tattadbravīthāstvaṃ yathā saṃdhirna no bhavet ||
vikāraṃ ko hi vismṛtya parākramadharo naraḥ |
vismartavyā tu neyaṃ me veṇī manyuniketanam ||

column5: vātāśca paruṣaṃ vānti kampate ca vasuṃdharā |

column3: sutakuśalakathābhiḥ svairamāśvāsya kuntīṃ punaraviśadudagraṃ dhāma duryodhanasya ||
bhoktuṃ tena nimantritaḥ praṇayitāṃ mithyā dadhānena sa bhuktiḥ prītipuraḥsarā vipadi kā prauḍhoktirityabravīt |
kṣatturmandirametya nirvṛtipadaṃ bhuktvā priyārho .nayattenaivākhiladharmanītividuṣā kurvankathāḥ śarvarīm ||
haṃsā iva vimānena śrotuṃ prāptaṃ caturmukham ||
bharatasya kuroḥ pūrvaṃ jāto .si nṛpa satkule |
tṛṣṇāmukhaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tyajyatāṃ mahatāṃ kule |
svayogyamāsasampūrṇaṃ na gehaṃ pakkaṇaṃ hi tat ||
tyāgaśca kaṅkaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ kiṃ teṣāṃ jaḍamaṇḍanaiḥ ||
bhīmasenamanāśritya ko nu prauḍhāṃ śriyaṃ bhajet ||
śatakratubhuvā tena śaṅkitaḥ ko nu rājate |
prajñānayana tāṃ satyāṃ kuru rājannito diśam |
ayācata raṇaṃ mūḍhā na hi śāmyantyapātitāḥ ||
iyaṃ bhogavatī nāma bhogināṃ subhagā purī |
sumukhasya vayaḥ kiṃ tu pratijñāto garutmatā ||
vṛta eva mayā putryai sumukhaḥ sadṛśo varaḥ |
kathaṃ me vṛttivicchedo bhavadbhyāṃ krīḍayā kṛtaḥ ||
savyetaraṃ vaha sakhe bāhuṃ me balināṃ vara |
satyamitāṃ tataste .haṃ jāne vāṇīṃ dhṛtiṃ tathā ||
ityuktvāsya bhujaṃ skandhe nidadhe sa hi līlayā |
duryodhana vṛthā darpaṃ mā kṛthā vyasanodayam ||
yāce vadāmi viharāmi harāmi śatrūnpremṇā bhaje nanu parāniti mūḍhavāñchā |
daivaṃ hi janmalikhitālikapaṭṭalekhāṃ dṛṣṭvā muhurmuhurudeti śubhāśubheṣu ||
gālavākhyo muniḥ śiṣyo viśvāmitraṃ guruṃ purā |
sa vayasyaṃ samabhyetya garuḍaṃ patatāṃ varam |
pūrvaṃ pūrvā diśaḥ prāpa devānāṃ pūrvamālayam ||
dakṣiṇāṃ ca tataḥ prāyātpitaro yatra somapāḥ ||
paścimāṃ ca tato gatvā paścādyatra raviḥ karān |
tataḥ siddhāṃ dadṛśatuḥ śāṇḍilīṃ nāma bhāsurām |
viṣṇoḥ śakrasya vā dhāmni dhyātveti virarāma saḥ ||
sapakṣaṃ śāṇḍilī cakre taṃ dṛśā balavattaram ||
kva te mahyaṃ pratijñātāḥ śyāmakarṇā hayāstvayā ||
uvāca garuḍo dhyātvā tasya kāryasya niścayam ||
divyaṃ premṇā mudā yuktau rakṣataḥ pṛthusaṃcayau ||
ityuktvā garuḍo gatvā yayātiṃ muninā saha |
haryaśvaṃ nāma sa nṛpaṃ vīraṃ matimatāṃ varam |
iti saṃvidamādāya sa tāṃ jagrāha vājibhiḥ ||
uvāca ṣaṭ śatānyeva pṛthivyāṃ santi vājinām ||
dattvā kanyāṃ ca tāṃ prādādgurave tanayāvadhi ||
punarāropitaḥ svarge putryā ca tapasā tayā ||
jayo vā saṃśayo lakṣmyā vadho vā svargado yudhi |
ta eva praṇatāḥ śatrau labhante na varāṭikām ||
taṃ bhrātuḥ putramāyātaṃ pariṣvajya hariṃ pṛthā |
ārjavaṃ brahmasulabhaṃ na te kṣatriya śobhate ||
spṛhaṇīyā varaṃ vandhyā na mātā śāntatejasām ||
ekastvaṃ dhīmatāṃ dhuryo yadi jānāsi kathyatām |
kiṃ tu bhuktaṃ ca pītaṃ ca visrabdhaṃ yasya mandire |
kirīṭinā mayi hate bhīmena ca suyodhane |
matkathāṃ naiva vācyo .sau jñātvā māṃ bhrātaraṃ hi saḥ |
tathā jāne na naḥ śeṣo gāṇḍīvena bhaviṣyati ||
asmadvaco na gṛhṇāti pathyaṃ bāla ivāturaḥ ||
dhruvaṃ pravṛtte nikhilā pṛthivī na bhaviṣyati ||
sā taṃ babhāṣe vātsalyāt kanīnastvaṃ suto mama |
bhuṅkṣva vīra mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ mā pāpānkauravānbhaja ||
bahiścaraṃ jīvitaṃ ca na tyājyo mama kauravaḥ |
sarvāvasthāsu yasyāhaṃ bandhuḥ svāmī guruḥ suhṛt ||
na haniṣyāmi mā te .stu praṇayo .yaṃ vṛthā mayi ||
mayā hate phalgune vā hate pārthena vā mayi |
na cāpametadityetāṃ viddhi me yudhi saṃvidam ||
śrutvā yudhiṣṭhiro bhīṣmaṃ kṛtaṃ senāpatiṃ paraiḥ |
pūrvaṃ bhīṣmeṇa no yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati mahaujasā |
yattā bhavantastiṣṭhantu śakyate na sa helayā ||
priyau śiṣyau sadā matvā śanaistaṃ deśamāyayau ||
rukmī nāma kare yasya māhendravijayaṃ dhanuḥ ||
gograhe vā sakhā kaścitko bhavenme bhavadvidhaḥ ||
tenāpi māninā tyaktaḥ sa jagāma nijāṃ purīm |
sa tena pṛṣṭaḥ provāca saṃniviṣṭe baladvaye |
rathaḥ sudakṣiṇo rājā saindhavo dviguṇo rathaḥ |
suśarmā sānujo vīro ratho vīrataro mama |
śāradvataḥ kṛpo vīro yūthapānāṃ tu yūthapaḥ |
rudrasya tejasā yukto drauṇiḥ śataguṇo rathaḥ |
puruṣaḥ katthano nīcaḥ karṇa eva rathottamaḥ ||
uvāca bata vṛddho .pi bhīṣma bālāyase dhiyā ||
satataṃ pāpa kaṭukaṃ bhāṣamāṇo na lajjase ||
śauryaṃ tejaśca śūrāṇāṃ vacasā gaṇyate katham ||
uccaiḥ kṛto .si mithyaiva kiṃ kurmo bhīṣma bhūbhujā ||
ahate tvayi gāṅgeya tasmādyotsye na pāṇḍavaiḥ ||
viśrānte yudhyamāne vā kā nāmāsyā raṇe tvayi ||

column5: viprā iti punaḥ pṛṣṭo rājñā śāntanavo .bravīt ||
column9: ke praṇamyā iti punaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śāntanavo .bravīt |

column3: svayaṃ yudhiṣṭhiro rājā yamau ca balināṃ varau |
rathe me yudhyamānasya latā iva cakampire ||
sālvarājo mayā pūrvaṃ manasā dayito vṛtaḥ |
sā gatvā sālvanṛpatiṃ saṃkalpaṃ vinivedya tam |
hṛtānyeneti tāṃ mānī na jagrāha kulodgataḥ ||
śiṣyo hi tasya vacasā guroḥ śantanunandanaḥ |
grahīṣyati parityaktāmapi tvāṃ mā śucaṃ kṛthāḥ ||
sa śrutvā pūjitaḥ kanyākathāṃ tāṃ hotravāhinīm |
putri madvacasā bhīṣmo na tvāṃ tyakṣyati gauravāt ||
uvāca bhīṣma kanyeyaṃ hṛtā tyaktā ca kiṃ tvayā ||
svayaṃ yātāṃ sālvapatiṃ tena tyaktāṃ ca madbhayāt |
yuyutsuṃ jāhnavī devī mātābhyetya jagāda mām ||
vīrā bhayapraṇāmeṣu bharatā na hi śikṣitāḥ ||
durjayo yudhi gāṅgeyaḥ kiṃ karomi nṛpātmaje |
adhunā kṣattriyaḥ śiṣyo mayā varjya iti bruvan |
sā yauvanavatī dṛṣṭvā śayyāyāṃ tāṃ śikhaṇḍinīm |
striyaṃ duḥkhārditā pitre dūtyā sarvaṃ nyavedayat ||
viṣaṇṇaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mātaraṃ ca śikhaṇḍinī |
praviśya sahasā tasthau nirāhārā ciraṃ śucā |
gatvā trāyasva pitaraṃ nijaṃ rūpaṃ prayaccha me ||
iti saṃvidamādāya visṛṣṭā tena sā yayau ||
dattaṃ vinimayāttena sā rūpaṃ prāpya pauruṣam |
yāto dadarśa strīrūpaṃ taṃ hriyā nodgataṃ puraḥ ||
strīrūpa eva pāpa tvaṃ narastvastu śikhaṇḍinī |
gaccha pāñcālya nedaṃ me strīrūpaṃ yujyate svayam |
iti yakṣavacaḥ śrutvā śikhaṇḍī svapuraṃ yayau |
evaṃ na strī na puruṣaḥ strīpūrvo drupadātmajaḥ |
varjyo yudhi mayā nityamiti me kṣatriyavratam ||
strīpūrve śaraṇaṃ yāte na śūraḥ śantanoḥ sutaḥ ||
śaktaḥ kṣapayituṃ kiṃ vā droṇaḥ karṇaḥ kṛpo .thavā ||
tato vihasya sotprāśaṃ bhīṣmaḥ karṇaṃ vigarhayan |
kālena kiyatā tāsāṃ kṣayaṃ phalguṇa manyase ||
astraṃ pāśupataṃ ghoraṃ priyaṃ devasya dhūrjaṭeḥ |
agresaraṃ tripathagātanayaṃ vidhāya yuddhāṅgaṇaṃ viviśurāśu vimuktadhāma ||
puṇye bhārgavabhinnabhūpanidhane kṣetre tataḥ kaurave kaunteyasya samantapañcakataṭe senāniveśo babhau |
suhmakrāthakirātacīnayavanā gauḍetraparyantajāḥ kṛcchreṇa kṣitipālalakṣanibiḍaṃ tatrāntaraṃ lebhire ||

column3: viṣamastho na hantavyo na ca senāvinirgataḥ |
na nivṛtte raṇe ceti maryādāṃ cakrire nṛpāḥ ||
divyaṃ gṛhāṇa nayanaṃ svayaṃ yuddhaṃ vilokaya |
ayaṃ te nikhilaṃ yuddhaṃ kathayiṣyati saṃjayaḥ |
saureṇa pīḍitā gāḍhaṃ rohiṇī jvalitā diśaḥ |
sthānaṃ sukṛtināṃ yatra vikhyātā gaṇḍikā iti ||
aho bata vimūḍhānāṃ rājyaleśe sukhāya naḥ |
nijāṃ kulasthitiṃ pārtha na dharmyāṃ hātumarhasi ||
saṃyuktaṃ vā viyuktaṃ vā nityaṃ dehena dehinam |
sahate yo viluptātmā nirvāṇaṃ tasya śāśvatam ||
sata evāsya satataṃ na virāmaḥ śarīriṇaḥ ||
jayājayau samaṃ matvā viśa svargonmukho raṇam ||
śreyo hyakarmaṇaḥ karma na yajñaḥ karmaṇā vinā |
taranti hi tamo ghoraṃ nityaṃ manmatavartinaḥ ||
iti pṛṣṭo hṛṣīkeśo jagāda jagatāṃ patiḥ |
yasya taṃ duḥsahaṃ śatruṃ kāmarūpa vināśaya ||
sūryeṇāptaḥ purā matto yogo .yaṃ manunā tataḥ |
na tatsmṛtipathaṃ yātaṃ kiṃtu te prāktanaṃ vapuḥ ||
ahaṃ tu nityadharmasya sthitaye guptaye satām |
svocitaṃ phalahīnaṃ ca viruddhaṃ ceti bhedataḥ ||
saktā api na sajanti paṅke ravikarā iva ||
brāhmaṇe vā śvapāke vā vibudhāḥ samadṛṣṭayaḥ ||
kriyāvān aphalākāṅkṣī nijaṃ karma karoti yaḥ |
ātmānaṃ māṃ ca sarvatra mamātmani tathākhilam |
ciraṃ bhuktvā sukhaṃ divyaṃ sa kalyāṇapuraḥsaraḥ ||
bhogināṃ yogināṃ vāpi sambhūto mahatāṃ kule |
mayi nyastamanā nityaṃ bhaktyā māṃ vetti mānava |
sarve matprāṇitā bhāvā mayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
devīṃ māyāṃ dadhānaṃ māṃ na jānāti vimohitaḥ |
ye tu jānanti māṃ māyāṃ bhavanti kṛtinaḥ sadā ||
arthī jijñāsurārto vā jñānī vā māṃ prapadyate |
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma japanto yānti te param ||
paraṃ māṃ pratipannāste na bhavanti bhave punaḥ ||
vairañce .smin ahorātre bhavanti na bhavanti ca |
sarvakartari bhūtāni mayi santi na teṣvaham |
lokāḥ sthitā na sthitāśca mayi vyomnīva vāyavaḥ ||
sarvaṃ sarvagataṃ yajñaṃ vedyaṃ bījaṃ bhavābhavam |
bhūyo .pi me śṛṇu sakhe prītyā yatpratibodhyase |
na tattvenāmaragaṇā munayo vā vidanti mām ||
tadahaṃ sarvabhūtātmā na hi kiṃcinmayā vinā ||
kiṃtu viśvamayaṃ rūpaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi te vibho ||
dīptyā dravanti rakṣāṃsi sthāne tava janārdana ||
anantaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma sarvātmānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||
ukto .si kṛṣṇa govinda yādaveti purā mayā ||
prasīda darśaya vibho vapuḥ saumyaṃ tadeva me |
śāntiṃ me yāti sahasā nānyathā vyathitaṃ manaḥ ||
devā api na paśyanti mamedaṃ sarvagaṃ vapuḥ |
vaśe yadi na te cittam abhyāsena gṛhāṇa tat |
udāsīnaḥ śucirdakṣaḥ kṣamī bhaktaḥ priyo mama |
kṣetraṃ tatsavikāraṃ tu māyā bhūtādi ca sthitam ||
jñeyaṃ tu manmayaṃ brahma śuddhaṃ sadasatoḥ param ||
prakṛtiḥ karaṇe heturbhoktā tu puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tatsaṃgamācca vistāraṃ sa yāti brahma śāśvatam |
bhautike .pi sthitaḥ kāye sarvavyāpī na lipyate ||
sattvaṃ prakāśakaṃ jñeyaṃ yadutthaiḥ stambhakaṃ rajaḥ |
guṇadoṣāśca dṛśyante te te kila śarīriṇām ||
abhīḥ sattvaṃ śucirjñānaṃ damo dānaṃ tapaḥ kratuḥ |
yukto .pi satataṃ divyasaṃpadā mā śucaḥ sakhe |
matkarma na parityājyaṃ tyājyaṃ tu vidhigarhitam ||
karma kartā ca buddhiśca trividhā guṇabhedataḥ |
dhṛtiḥ sukhaṃ ca traiguṇyāttrividhaṃ dehināṃ matam ||
yathoktasevī niḥsaṅgaḥ kuru karma nijaṃ sakhe |
idaṃ bhaktāya te jñānamupadiṣṭaṃ mayā svayam |
abhyāyayau tava sutaḥ svakurūnnirasya dhāvanti tulyaguṇameva nṛṇāṃ manāṃsi ||
atha bhīmaṃ samabhyāyāt svayaṃ rājā suyodhanaḥ |
anye ca vīrā rājāno rājasiṃhāḥ prahāriṇaḥ |
sa kuñjarendraḥ śalyasya pādena caturo hayān |
tato madrādhipaḥ kruddhaḥ śaktiṃ śaktimatāṃ varaḥ |
tasya śalyo .tha gadayā vidārya dalaśo ratham |
śaṅkho hatāśvaḥ sahasā phalguṇasya rathaṃ yayau |
ko mucyeta raṇe prāpya bhīṣmaṃ bhīṣmaparākramam ||
mithaḥ kathayatāṃ teṣāṃ sā jagāma vibhāvarī ||
na dadarśa tayoḥ kaścidantaraṃ kṣipatoḥ śarān |
yattu śakyaṃ mayā kiṃcidvṛddhenādya karomi kim ||

column3: tiṣṭhantu yāntu vā sarve sātyake pṛtanāgragāḥ |
eṣa svayaṃ nihanmyadya sānugaṃ śantanoḥ sutam ||
na rūpaṃ sehire draṣṭuṃ surā api divi sthitāḥ ||
sa hatvā cāmaraṃ śūraḥ pauravyatanayaṃ nṛpam |
devena viṣṇunā guptā na jeyāḥ pāṇḍavā iti ||
prādurbhūtaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭāva sahasāṃ nidhim ||
avatīrṇā bhuvaṃ nātha dānavā ye hatāstvayā |
iti stutāḥ padmabhuvā devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
iti jñātvā śamaḥ putra kriyatāṃ pāṇḍunandanaiḥ ||
hatānāṃ hanyamānānāṃ ghnatāṃ ca samare mithaḥ |
bhūriśravāḥ śirāṃsy ārād uccakarta śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ||
sa hatāśvaṃ samutsṛjya rathaṃ putrasya saṃbhramāt |
mādrīsutau tataḥ śalyaṃ vidhāya virathaṃ śaraiḥ |
svayaṃ yudhiṣṭhiro rājā nṛpaṃ jitvā śrutāyudham |
mahodaraṃ maṇḍitakaṃ sunābhaṃ ca nihatya tān ||
sa niṣaṅgaṃ dhanurdīptaṃ nanāda balināṃ varaḥ ||
tato māyāṃ samāśritya mahatīṃ mohanīṃ nṛṇām |
na sehire taṃ bhūpālā māninaḥ saṃhatā api ||
draupadeyaiḥ puraḥ prāptaiḥ sa vidhāya raṇaṃ kṣaṇam |
khadyotā iva vṛkṣeṣu śalabhā iva śāliṣu |
rājñāṃ hatānāṃ bhīṣmeṇa jīvā iva nabhaścarāḥ ||
yasya tvaṃ jagatāṃ nātho vadhāya svayamudyataḥ ||
jagāda rājakaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhinnaṃ bhīṣmeṇa duḥkhitaḥ ||
alaṃ rājyena me tāvaditi vādini dharmaje |
iti niścitya kṛṣṇena bhrātṛbhiśca sahāśu kṛt |
na taṃ paśyāmi lokeṣu vīro māṃ vijayeta yaḥ |
jayalābhe ca yuṣmākaṃ mayi jīvati kā kathā ||
na viśastrena saṃtraste na strīpūrve mameṣavaḥ |
akāma iva duḥkhena yayau svaśibiraṃ nṛpaḥ ||
yudhi yudhyasva vā mā vā na me jīvangamiṣyasi ||
bhīṣmo .pi tam anādṛtya viddhvā kṛṣṇārjunau śaraiḥ |
vadhāya kuru kaunteya yatnaṃ me nṛpatikṣayāt |
vimānā iva gāṅgeyo mahāstraṃ saṃjahāra tat |
śaikhaṇḍīṃ śaramālāṃ tāṃ śairīṣīm iva peśalām ||
viśanti mama marmāṇi bilaṃ viṣadharā iva |
sthito .smīti ca gāṅgeyo nigadya yaśasāṃ nidhiḥ ||
jagrāha śāsanāttasya tribhiḥ pārthaḥ śaraiḥ śiraḥ ||

column3: bāhlikaṃ śakuniṃ droṇiṃ vṛṣasenaṃ ca gautamam |
tayoḥ pārtho rathau hatvā chittvā ca dhanuṣī śaraiḥ |
ayaṃ sa kartā darpāndho nikārāṇāṃ sthavīyasām |
jñātaṃ kṛṣṇa mayā yena pāpo .yaṃ pratibhāṃ śritaḥ ||
cicheda bāṇairmarmāṇi chattrāṇi ca dhanūṃṣi ca ||
hatāśvaṃ kṛttacāpaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sarve yudhiṣṭhiram |
hṛto hṛto nṛpa iti sphāratāraṃ pracukruśuḥ ||
saha devarathenāśu muktvā droṇaṃ yayau nṛpaḥ ||
uvāca sātyakiṃ matvā sa dhuryaṃ sarvadhanvinām ||
sātyake paśya bandhūnāṃ gurūṇāṃ suhṛdāṃ tathā |
sa te guruḥ sakhā bandhuḥ kirīṭī śatrumadhyagaḥ |
na jñāyate praṇaṣṭe .tra śaṅkhaśabde kathaṃ sthitaḥ ||
dhanyā bhavadvidhā eva kriyate yaiḥ sthiraṃ yaśaḥ |
guro śiṣyaṃ tavānveṣṭuṃ phalguṇaṃ prasthitasya me |
na praveṣṭuṃ tvayā śakyaṃ mayi jīvati sātyake ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vihvalaṃ droṇo babhāṣe pārśvavartinam |
ko .yaṃ te saṃbhramo vīra gatvā rakṣa jayadratham ||
kṛtavairaśca mānī ca yoddhavye vidruto .si kim ||
naiṣā sabhā sā pāñcālīṃ yatra tvaṃ kṛṣṭavānasi |
tasya tūrṇaṃ śitairbāṇairguruḥ kṛtvā yudhi kṣayam |
yathā na śrūyate bhīma śaṅkhaśabdaḥ kirīṭinaḥ |
mām anirjitya kaunteya bhettuṃ śakyā na vāhinī ||
tvadvidhaiḥ kururājasya saṃrambhaṃ mā kṛthā vṛthā |
yathā tvaṃ manyase droṇa nedānīṃ no gururbhavān ||
vidrutaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ droṇaḥ punarādravat ||
sainyaṃ puraśca paścācca gṛhītaṃ dhāryate katham |
gurvīṃ gadāṃ visṛjyāsya niṣpipeṣa rathaṃ javāt ||
bhuvi sthitaṃ śarairbhinnaṃ karṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā suyodhanaḥ |
hateṣu teṣu rādheyo dhunāno vipulaṃ dhanuḥ |
tasya bhīmo dhanuśchittvā rathaṃ ca guruvikramaḥ |
viṣamasthaṃ raṇe karṇo na jaghāna vṛkodaram |
vīraḥ kuntīvacaḥ smṛtvā satyaśīlā hi sādhavaḥ ||
garjitaṃ cakitāḥ sarve rājahaṃsā na sehire ||
chittvā parasparaṃ cāpaṃ syandanaṃ sampramathya ca |
samudyataḥ śiro hartuṃ śiṣyasya tava sātyakeḥ ||
aho vīravrataṃ pārtha kīdṛśaṃ darśitaṃ tvayā |
hantā śiṣyasya sakhyuśca kṛttahastaḥ kṛto yadi |
tatra kiṃ nāma manyadhvaṃ nirdoṣā yūyamāhave ||
yayāce praṇataḥ pūrvaṃ raṇaṃ prāyajuṣo ripoḥ ||
chinddhi sindhupateḥ kṣipraṃ śiro divyena patriṇā ||
bhīmo nanarda taṃ nādaṃ hataṃ matvā jayadratham |
akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta hatvā hataḥ pārthena saindhavaḥ |
nūnaṃ na durgaṃ daivasya kiṃcidityūcire janāḥ ||
droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ ca vidadhe śarairjiṣṇuḥ parāṅmukham ||
āruroha rathaṃ vīro vitīrṇaṃ hariṇā nijam ||
tato yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prāpya tau ca sātyakiphalguṇau |
ūce tvayā kṛtāśvāso nihataḥ sa jayadrathaḥ ||
na kūṇitāni netrāṇi rātrau bhūtāni sehire ||
tato vimohinīṃ māyāṃ drauṇiḥ kruddhasya rakṣasaḥ |
loke satyam avīre .smin ekastvaṃ vīratāṃ gataḥ ||
aho nu mithyā rādheya kathitena tavāmunā |
dṛṣṭasārā vayaṃ sarve tava pāṇḍusutasya ca |
balānusāraṃ yudhyasva vṛthā ślāghāṃ tu mā kṛtāḥ ||
tvaṃ tu vṛddha nirācāro mohādevaṃ prabhāṣase |
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tato jitvā vīraṃ hatvāsya cānugān |
na jaghāna raṇe karṇaḥ smarankuntīvaco muhuḥ ||
taṃ karṇaṃ sāyakāneva kirantaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim |
na sehire pare draṣṭuṃ raṇe tapanasaṃbhavam ||
tato bhuvi viniṣpiṣya rāviṇaṃ taṃ ghaṭotkacaḥ |
viddho .pi rakṣasā karṇo na cacāla mahāśayaḥ ||
muhurgajo muhuḥ siṃhaḥ kṣaṇaṃ meghaḥ kṣaṇaṃ giriḥ |
bhuvo vahniṃ divaḥ śastraṃ digbhyo rākṣasamaṇḍalam |
tato vidhūya tāṃ māyāṃ karṇo divyāstratejasā |
bhaimaḥ sasarja karṇāya svayaṃ rudreṇa nirmitām ||
tāṃ gadāṃ gadayā rakṣo hatvā jāmbūnadāṅgadām |
tejasvino rākṣasasya dṛḍhaṃ vakṣo vidārya sā |
dharmavīra tyaja krodhaṃ sadā dharmānugo jayaḥ ||
na śarma lebhire vīrāḥ pīḍitā droṇasāyakaiḥ ||
saṃchādya cakratuḥ kṣipraṃ vismayaṃ tava dhanvinām ||
putraṃ tu nihataṃ śrutvā dhruvameṣa na yotsyate |
durjayaṃ tanayaṃ matvā droṇo mene na tattathā ||
munisaṃghe gate vyomnā droṇo bhīmavacaḥ smaran |
aho nu brāhmaṇo bhūtvā piśitāśīva niṣkṛpaḥ |
karoṣi kaluṣaṃ karma nihate .pi priye sute ||
tacchrutvā sahasā droṇastyaktvā cāpaṃ saha krudhā |
śrutvā sa vaiśasaṃ ghoraṃ chadmanā vihitaṃ gurau |
mayi jīvati kaunteyaḥ kathaṃ prāpsyati medinīm ||
ityuktvā saṃdadhe dīptaṃ tadastraṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ |
tvayi kṛṣṇe ca kiṃ nāma drauṇiślāghābhinandyate ||
tvayā hataḥ kathaṃ bhīṣmaḥ sa ca prāgjyotiṣeśvaraḥ |
bata pāpa vayaṃ sarve ye gurughnaṃ puraḥ sthitam |
aho nu paradoṣajño nirdoṣa iva bhāṣase ||
kriyatāṃ nādhunā yuddhaṃ svasti pārthāya dhīmate |
evaṃ vahniṃ pravekṣyāmi drauṇiṃ kālaṃ saheta kaḥ ||
bho bhoḥ śastraṃ parityajya rathebhyo vrajata kṣitim |
astreṇānena hanyante na viśastrā bhuvi sthitāḥ ||
astre tataḥ svayaṃ śānte prasanne bhuvanatraye |
sa sātyakiṃ pārṣataṃ ca jitvā vidrāvya vāhinīm |
jaghāna pauravaṃ vīraṃ rājānaṃ ca sudarśanam ||
rathaṃ samutsṛjya tamugrakarmā praṇamya papraccha gurostanūjaḥ |
sa eṣa durjayaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ liṅgārcanavrataḥ |
yaṃ namaskṛtya varadaṃ rājante divi devatāḥ |
smaraharamasurāriṃ taṃ smara smerakāntiṃ haramajaramajayyaṃ śāśvataṃ viśvarūpam |
ityāgrahāt paramam āgrahamindrasūnoḥ prītyā vidhāya munimaulimaṇau prayāte |
bhūpāḥ praviśya śibirāṇi dināvasāne cakruḥ kathāḥ pravaravīrakathānubaddhāḥ ||

column3: miśrībhūteṣu bhūpānāṃ ratheṣu ca gajeṣu ca |
nṛpaṃ māṃ sūtaputrasya sūtaṃ kartuṃ yadicchasi ||
purā pinākinaṃ devaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
sarvadevamayaṃ kṛtvā rathaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca sāyakam ||
tataḥ śakramukhā devā vicārya suciraṃ dhiyā |
adya śakraḥ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā nihatamarjunam |
divyāstreṣu dṛśaḥ śaṅke sāsūyaṃ kṣipati kṣaṇāt ||
taṃ samutsahase jetuṃ karṇa karṇo .si kiṃ na vā ||
nirguṇastvaṃ na jānīṣe na māṃ na ca dhanaṃjayam ||
sa ca māṃ vetti tattvena tvaṃ mithyā tu pragalbhase ||
ayaṃ mitropadhiḥ śatruḥ kenāpi preṣito .si naḥ |
uvāca mūḍha bahuśo hitamuktaṃ na budhyase ||
ekastu haṃso jaladhau vrajāva iti saṃvidā |
yuṣmadvidhānāṃ vacasā jāyate na bhayaṃ mama |
lakṣyābhyāse mayā vatsaḥ purā bāṇena dāritaḥ |
tvaṃ tu kevalayānena nṛpeṇa vāhinā vṛtaḥ |
mayā svayaṃ saṃnikarṣe dvijihvaḥ kuṭilo vṛtaḥ ||
abhakṣyaṃ bhuñjate nityam apātavyaṃ pibanti ye |
agamyāsu ramante ca te madrāstava bāndhavāḥ ||
vikrīyante sadā yatra dārāḥ putrāśca mānavaiḥ |
hatvā śarairunmamātha dhvajaṃ cāpaṃ cakarta ca ||
bhittvā vaikartanaḥ śaktiṃ tāṃ ghaṇṭākrandinīṃ muhuḥ |
pāśahastaṃ kavacinaṃ krodhaṃ ca sa mahābhujam |
tāvantyeva rathānāṃ ca cakre bhūmibhujāṃ kṣayam ||
babhūva pāṇḍave sainye ghoro vyatikaro navaḥ ||
kupitena ca bhīmena te sene pravidārite |
kṣaṇena nikhilāṃ syūtāṃ tāṃ senāṃ kurute nṛpaḥ |
sa diṣṭyā samare pārtha tvayā karṇo nipātitaḥ ||
vīrāḥ sa vidviṣāṃ hantā dhaureyaḥ sarvadhanvinām |
mithyaiva kuntyā garbhe tvaṃ kṣatriyavyañjano dhṛtaḥ ||
ka eva nāma jānīte karṇādbhīto dhanaṃjayaḥ ||
etadgirā dadau khaḍge kruddhaḥ sāśrulavā dṛśaḥ |
taṃ kopasaṃkaṭo ghore duḥkhāgnau ca nirantare ||
jāne te hṛdgataṃ pārtha yena dolāyase muhuḥ ||
gāṇḍīvaṃ vitarānyasmai tvāṃ brūyādyaḥ sa te dhruvam |
tadarthamasi kopāndho nihantuṃ kiṃ svid agrajam |
dharmo .pi gahanaḥ sūkṣmo jñāyate na yathā tathā |
purā babhūva vipine balāko nāma lubdhakaḥ ||
kṣaṇaṃ babhūva patitaiḥ sā kabandhamayīva bhūḥ ||
na sehire raṇe dīptaṃ karṇasūnoḥ parākramam ||
durjayaḥ samare karṇaḥ sthiro yudhyasva phalguṇa ||
taṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca karṇo bāṇairapūrayat ||
khāṇḍave kṛtavairaṃ taṃ khaṃ vrajantaṃ mahoragam |
chittvā ṣaḍbhiḥ śaraiḥ pārthaḥ karṇaṃ punaratāḍayat ||
hatvā tamastraṃ rādheyo jyāṃ cicheda kirīṭinaḥ |
uvāca karṇaḥ kaunteyaṃ muhūrtaṃ kṣamatāṃ bhavān ||
vyasanasthe viśastre ca nahi śūrā bhavādṛśaḥ ||
diṣṭyādya karṇa jānīṣe dharmaṃ vīravrate sthitaḥ ||
bahubhirnihato bālaḥ saubhadraḥ kiṃ nu vismṛtaḥ |

column3: ūce prātaḥ samāśvāsya mama kṣatrocitā gatiḥ ||
iti teṣāṃ samālāpaṃ śrutvā jñātvā suyodhanam |
aho vīra yaśaḥ śubhraṃ bhavatā malinīkṛtam ||
uttiṣṭha yuddhe svāṃ lakṣmīṃ tridivaṃ vā samāpnuhi |
lābhaḥ samo hi vīrāṇāṃ vijayo nidhanaṃ nu vā ||
bandhusvajanahīnā tu lakṣmīḥ kasya manaḥ spṛśet ||
svajanena vinā lakṣmīḥ kasya prīṇāti mānasam ||
sa karṇaḥ suhṛdāmagryaḥ sa guruḥ sa pitāmahaḥ |
sūcyagramapi na tyājyaṃ pāṇḍavānprati te bhuvaḥ |
uttiṣṭha yuddhamekena tavāstu vijitaḥ sa cet |
jitāḥ sarve tvayā rājanmā pralāpaiḥ kṛśo bhava ||
sāvalepaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā na sahante hi māninaḥ ||
utthitaḥ sa babhau rājā daṇḍadhāra ivāparaḥ ||
sa cakre mānasaṃ yajñaṃ tato devāḥ samabhyayuḥ ||
tato vinaśanaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpa yatra sarasvatī |
viveśa naimiṣaṃ rāmo yatra prācī sarasvatī |
tatra rāmo dadau bhūri dhanaṃ vārṣṇeyanandanaḥ |
yatra sarvagataṃ brahma devalāya jagau muniḥ ||
tasmiṃstīrthe balaḥ snātvā yayau yatra purā vapuḥ |
nāradaḥ prāha nodvāhaṃ vinā svargo bhavediti |
kṛtvā lalitamākāraṃ tridivaṃ ca yayau tataḥ |
tatra snātvā ca dattvā ca plakṣaprasravaṇe tathā ||
māyayā nihatā daityā māyāvadhyā hi māyinaḥ |
eṣa lokabhayaṃ bhīme vidhāya gadayā śramam ||
duryodhano .tha nipapāta divaṃ vilokya vajrāvapātahatapakṣa ivādrirājaḥ ||
asminmahīparivṛḍhe patite ca bhūmau kairninditaṃ na bhavabhaṅgurabhaṅgi janma ||
dṛṣṭvā śiraḥ padā spṛṣṭaṃ bhīmena jagatībhujaḥ |
śiro vyājahatasyāsya kaḥ spṛśed apaśuḥ padā ||
vadhaḥ kṣatrocitaḥ prāptaḥ ko .nyo .sti sadṛśo mayā ||
bhrūbhaṅgena nivāsitā vanabhuvaṃ śuṣyanmukhāḥ śatravo dṛṣṭā śrīḥ svayamarpitāgryasuhṛdāmuṣṇīṣahārasmitā |
saṃgrāme .pyaparāṅmukhasya nidhanaṃ dikṣu prarūḍhaṃ yaśaḥ kartavyaṃ spṛhaṇīyam anyad ucitaṃ yuktaṃ kimastyāyuṣaḥ ||
nṛpaiḥ saha yayuḥ pārthā nādayanto rathairjayam ||
na ca dharmāccyutāḥ pārthāstena tena padaṃ ruṣaḥ ||
munāvāśvāsya yāte ca śeṣaṃ papraccha saṃjayam ||
dadṛśuḥ kauravapatiṃ nītaṃ kālena tāṃ daśām ||

column3: tatra tau vilapantau ca kṣipantau ca tanuṃ bhuvi |
sa dīnaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau hataputraṃ nareśvaram |
abhāvaḥ prākca paścācca dehināṃ satataṃ sthitaḥ |
sa ca yātastathā kṛtvā kastvaṃ tasya sa kastava ||
namaḥ kālāya yaḥ ko .pi vidyate mṛtyunā vṛtaḥ |
pāṇḍavā bhrātaraṃ smṛtvā kāluṣyaṃ teṣu mā kṛthāḥ ||
gāndhārīṃ brūhi sahasā mohe majjati no yathā |
iti teṣāṃ girā kṣipraṃ samohaṃ kauraveśvaram |
śocanti yāḥ purā dṛṣṭā na sūryeṇa na cendunā ||
dorbhyāṃ ca bhuvamāliṅgya kathaṃ supto .si bhūpate ||
ayaṃ te dayitaḥ putro lakṣmaṇaḥ śatruṇā hataḥ |
sajīva iva vaktuṃ tvaṃ nātha kiṃcitsamīhate ||
yaḥ sa kaṅkaṇajhāṅkārair vyajanair vijito nṛpaḥ |
bhūmimāliṅgya kiṃ śeṣe priyāmadya vihāya mām ||
tvaṃ śakrasadṛśaḥ śaurye kathameko hataḥ paraiḥ ||
tvāṃ svayaṃ bhāṣyamāṇāṃ māṃ kathaṃ na pratibhāṣase ||
prahṛtaṃ tvaccharīre yair dhik tān dagdhavilocanān ||
vilokya tāraṃ krośantī ruddhā sakhyeva mūrcchayā ||
nāmni saṃkīrtite yasya prāpurnidrāṃ na śatravaḥ |
sa tvamadya hataḥ śeṣe dhikkālasya durantatām ||
kṛtvā yaḥ śakratulyatvaṃ na cakre kalpasākṣiṇam ||
paśya jāmātaraṃ kṛṣṇa hataṃ mama jayadratham |
bālā śociti matputrī na ca jānāti śocitum ||
paśya droṇasya samare vahneḥ śāntārciṣo yathā |
nikṛte jiṣṇunā manye yaśo nirlūnam ātmanaḥ ||
ṣaḍviṃśe vatsare prāpte vṛṣṇīnāṃ samare mithaḥ |
gatiṃ papraccha vīrāṇāṃ parimāṇaṃ ca saṃkṣaye ||
aprahṛṣṭā hatā ye ca te gandharvapuraṃ gatāḥ ||

column3: diṣṭyā śalyādayo vīrā yātā vṛtrasamāḥ kṣayam ||
te hatāḥ svajanāḥ sarve gato niṣphalatāṃ śramaḥ ||
idaṃ dahati me ceto yatkarṇo vinipātitaḥ |
sa hi me kathitaḥ kuntyā bhrātā tapanasaṃbhavaḥ ||
asmadarthe raho mātrā yācitaḥ sa mahāyaśāḥ |
iti rājñā viṣaṇṇena pṛṣṭaḥ provāca nāradaḥ ||
brahmāstraṃ tacca na dadau droṇo .smai phalguṇapriyāt ||
iti śaptaḥ sa vipreṇa dahyamāna ivāniśam |
gṛdhro nāma surārātiḥ śapto .haṃ muninā purā ||
ityuktvā rākṣase yāte karṇaṃ papraccha bhārgavaḥ |
kulaṃ nāma ca yenāśu taṃ śaśāpa ruṣā guruḥ ||
jarāsaṃdho dadau tasmai mālinīṃ nagarīṃ jitaḥ |
anye ca tatyajurvīrā bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ nareśvarāḥ ||
śaptaḥ pūrvaṃ dvijendreṇa guruṇā bhārgavena ca ||
śalyena tejasaḥ śāntyai śrāvitaḥ paruṣā giraḥ ||
yātaḥ sa sūryasadanaṃ saṃmukhaṃ samare hataḥ |
yatsarvaṃ tyajati kṣipraṃ naraḥ kṣība ivāmbaram |
yathā hi śocyastyaktārtho na tathā tyaktajīvitaḥ ||
bata deva jaḍasyeva buddhiste durgrahe dṛḍhā |
aghātayitvā pṛthivīṃ kiṃ naiṣā dhīstvayā kṛtā ||
padā kṣipasi kiṃ rājangataṃ na prāpyate punaḥ |
madhumatto yathā śete tathā tvaṃ kartumudyataḥ |
kiṃ vānyatpatitāḥ sarve tadaiva vyasane vayam ||
yadaiva tvaṃ grāmakāmastvaṃ dhātrā jyeṣṭhaḥ kṛto .si naḥ |
tiṣṭhatyaṅke na ca skandhe kaṣṭaṃ bāla ivāturaḥ |
vane kuraṅgamātaṅgā na tu dṛṣṭā divaṃ gatāḥ |
śakuniḥ so .tha taiḥ pṛṣṭo jagāda vihasanniva ||
evaṃ te bodhitā yuktvā khagarūpeṇa vajriṇā |
anutsāhena te paśya likhantyete mṛṣā bhuvam |
bhajasva vijayotthānāṃ na klībāḥ saṃpadāṃ padam |
rājanvane na mokṣo .sti bandho nāsti gṛheṣu ca ||
gaccha pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ bhrātaḥ svayaṃ rājñe nivedaya ||
chinnahastaḥ sa ca yayau prahṛṣṭo bhrāturantikam ||

column3: kṣayaṃ kālakṛtaṃ vīkṣya mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ ||
bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyante kālena kalitāḥ kila |
dṛṣṭvā jagati jantūnāṃ kāle kāle bhavābhavam |
śakto hyāyuṣi maryādāṃ yaḥ kālavihitāṃ bhavet ||
na hi kālakaṭākṣeṇa lakṣitaṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamāḥ ||
śokaḥ kiṃ tatra jantūnāṃ satataṃ hi gatāgatam ||
na viyogeṣu saṃtāpaḥ kāryaḥ kila vivekibhiḥ |
sarve niḥsīmni saṃsāre yānti kaḥ kena śocyate ||
te janāste prabhāvāśca tāśca prajvalitāḥ śriyaḥ |
yasya yajñe surapatiḥ somaṃ pītvā mudaṃ yayau ||
īje yaḥ so .pi bharataḥ kālena tridivaṃ gataḥ ||
pradadau yasya saṃkhyāṃ ca yajñānāṃ na pracakṣate ||
srutaiḥ pravartitā tena puṇyā carmaṇvatī nadī ||
atītaḥ sa ca bhūpālaḥ sagaro yena sāgarāḥ |
so .pi śakrādhipo rājā priyaṃ tatyāja vigraham ||
ete cānye ca bhūpālāḥ kālena kavalīkṛtāḥ |
mā śucas tava madvākyātputraḥ sṛñjaya jīvatu ||
taṃ tasya hṛdgataṃ bhāvaṃ gūhamānasya lajjayā |
iti tena ruṣā śaptaḥ kopāttamapi nāradaḥ |
prītyā babhūvatuḥ svasthau tau parityajya vikriyām ||
ataḥ śeṣāṃ kathāmeṣa svayaṃ vadatu nāradaḥ |
yathārthaṃ kāñcanaṣṭhīvī na sehe taṃ śatakratuḥ ||
kālena yātastridivaṃ sthāyino na hi dehinaḥ ||
punaḥ punarimāṃ hutvā vahnau pātakinīṃ tanum |
kṣayaṃ yāsyati manye no na bhīṣmavadhapātakam ||
kṛtvā kulocitaṃ karma mā viṣādaṃ vṛthā kṛthāḥ ||
iti bruvāṇo bhagavānrājñā pṛṣṭo muniḥ punaḥ |
prāyaścittaṃ na tu strīṇāṃ rajasā saṃvṛtā hitāḥ |
gaccha śāntanavaṃ bhīṣmaṃ sa te dharmānpravakṣyati ||
iti bruvāṇe cārvāke viṣaṇṇe ca yudhiṣṭhire |
tato vidhāya bandhūnāṃ rājā śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi |
gāndhārīṃ svāṃ ca jananīṃ praṇamya racitāñjaliḥ ||
sa me bahumataḥ śrīmānyoginaṃ cintayāmi tam |
ye māṃ smaranti satataṃ dehatyāge smarāmi tān ||
tadehi sarve gacchāmastaṃ draṣṭuṃ tejasāṃ nidhim |
tuṣṭāva prayato dhyātvā viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ jagaddviṣām ||

column3: yā pūrvakoṭirbhāvānāṃ sattāṃ tāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ namaḥ ||
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ pāre tamasāṃ mahasāṃ tathā ||
dhanyatā māninī manye vahati tvāṃ vasuṃdharā ||
vyathito dharmatanayo na kvāpi labhate dhṛtim ||
rathaiḥ śāntanavaṃ draṣṭuṃ prātaḥ sarve samāyayuḥ ||
kiṃ tu pṛcchatu māṃ rājā dharmaniṣṭho yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
vṛtte kṣatrocite kārye na lajjā kartumarhati |
sa tena mūrdhnyupāghrāya pṛccha māmiti coditaḥ ||
prajānāṃ pālane dharmaṃ pūrvaṃ papraccha dharmajaḥ |
tato jagāda gāṅgeyaḥ praṇamya manasā harim ||
śṛṇu putra yathā rājye virājante nareśvarāḥ |
rājñāṃ śriyo hi tadvākyādbhavanti na bhavanti ca ||
rājavṛttiriyaṃ pūrvā yanna tīvraṃ na mārdavam |
suṣiraṃ kurvate rājyaṃ svāṃ khaniṃ mūṣikā iva ||
hayaṃ rathaṃ gajaṃ vāso rājayogyaṃ tathāsanam |
āruhya rājñā spardhante vismaranti ca bhṛtyatām ||
bahu dattaṃ na manyante yācante durlabhānyapi |
prajānāṃ dalane saktā na tu te rājasaṃmatāḥ ||
ko hi paśyedimaṃ lokaṃ gāḍhena tamasā vṛtam |
rājñaḥ śaśāṅkayaśasaḥ pratāpo yadi na sphuret ||
venaṃ nāma sutaṃ tasyāṃ samprāpya tapase yayau |
venasya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ nirmathya munayaḥ punaḥ |
yathā lokāḥ prakāśante na sūryeṇa na cendunā ||
pṛṣṭo jijñāsayā tena sa rājā praṇipatya tam |
durbalaṃ ghnanti balinaḥ sevante ca parastriyaḥ |
na ca dharmāḥ pravartante na ca varṣati vāsavaḥ ||
kuto dhanaṃ kuto dārāḥ śarīraṃ ca kuto nṛṇām |
ciraṃ prajāḥ svadharmasthāḥ pālayitvā divaṃ yayau ||
maittraḥ syād akhalāsaṅgī yudhyeta na tu bandhubhiḥ |
sevetārcyānna tu stabdho bhavecchiṣyo na māyayā |
āśāṃ sṛjenna viphalāṃ vibhajeta na niṣṭhuram ||
brāhmaṇāḥ sarvadā rājñā mūrdhni kāryā bubhūṣatā |
brāhmeṇa tejasā yuktaṃ balaṃ kṣātraṃ hi duḥsaham ||
aiḍena bhūbhujā pṛṣṭaḥ purā provāca mārutaḥ |
brāhmaṇānāmiyaṃ pṛthvī dhanaṃ vā jātu rakṣitam ||
mucukundaḥ purā rājā vijitya sakalā diśaḥ |
pṛthunā mucukundasya tejasā ca kṣayaṃ yayuḥ |
tataḥ prāptāḥ kubereṇa dattāṃ vasumatīṃ nṛpaḥ |
na bhetavyaṃ tvayā citta rāṣṭre me nāsti viplavaḥ ||
nāyajvā na vikarmastho na pāpī na kulacyutaḥ |
iti bruvāṇaṃ nṛpatiṃ sa tatyāja niśācaraḥ |
viśvasenna ca sarvatra na ca śaṅketa pārthivaḥ |
viśvāsī cātiśaṅkī ca sarvathā vipadāṃ padam ||
āpteṣvapi na viśvāsaḥ kartavyaḥ kila bhūbhujā |
na śarīrāṇi cetāṃsi sthirāṇi na hi dehinām ||
na śṛṇvanti na manyante girā māṃ vyathayanniva ||
kośādhyakṣaḥ svayaṃ rājā parirakṣyaḥ śuciḥ sadā |
amātyā na sahante taṃ goptāraṃ kośahāriṇaḥ ||
sa nivedya sadā rājñe pratyakṣaṃ samadarśayat ||
te sarve kaṇṭakaṃ matvā saṃhatya nṛpajīvinaḥ |
suptaṃ taṃ vāyasaṃ rātrau jaghnurbāṇena nirjane ||
sa tairme nihataḥ kākaḥ prāha yo māṃ bhava dvitam |
rājāpi tadgirā kāle śoṣayitvā krameṇa tān |
dānena bhedayitvā ca cakre niṣkaṇṭakāṃ śriyam ||
tathā śaśāsa yaśasā yathā jīvanniva sthitaḥ ||
śṛṇoti karuṇākrandaṃ śrutvā ca trāyate bhayāt |
nāvicārya sṛjeddaṇḍaṃ yaḥ sa sarvapriyo nṛpaḥ ||
na yudhyate kṣatriyo yaḥ sa dharmavijayī nṛpaḥ ||
tathā manye na śocyaḥ śvā mṛto viṇmūtrakardame |
yasya pṛṣṭhaṃ na paśyanti yudhyamānasya śatravaḥ |
sa hataḥ svargamāsādya śakreṇa spardhate nṛpaḥ ||
ambarīṣaḥ purā rājā yajvā prāpya surālayam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ śakraṃ papraccha sa mahīpatiḥ ||
iṣṭvā dattvā ca taptvā ca prāpto .haṃ tvatpurīmimām ||
uvāca śrīryathā rājñāṃ na karoti taḍidbhramam ||
ghoreṇa kalahenāpto jaghanyo hi jayaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sāmnā seveta balinaṃ lubdhaṃ dānena sādhayet |
na bhāṣate vepate ca lakṣitaḥ kṣmāṃ nirīkṣate |
tathāpi yadi te vāñchā sve rājye śatruṇā hate |
gatvā tameva sevasva maunaṃ kṛtvā kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
praviśya ca manaḥ prītyā priyavādī yathā tathā |
dūto bhūtvā svayaṃ saṃdhau tasya śatrumayo .jayat ||
vitatāra sutāṃ tasmai vibhavaṃ ca yathocitam ||
samyagvṛttena satyena vartante hi gaṇāḥ sadā ||
praśāmyati bahiḥ kopo rājñāṃ sāmādibhiḥ kṣaṇāt |
daivataṃ pitaro yasya dharmo yasya prajāhitam |
samyagdaṇḍo vrataṃ yasya sa rājā yajvanāṃ varaḥ ||
na satyaṃ kevalaṃ satyamanṛtaṃ na tathānṛtam |
bhavanti puruṣā loke tāṃśca budhyeta bhūmipaḥ ||
kālena pañcatāṃ yātaḥ sa ca prāptaḥ śṛgālatām |
manaḥ śuddhikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pramāṇaṃ karma dehinām ||
iti bruvāṇaṃ taṃ sarve vijñāya dṛḍhaniścayam |
uvāca mama sācivyaṃ śuddhātmā bhajatāṃ bhavān ||
svācchandyamamṛtaṃ tyaktvā kaḥ sevāṃ vikaṭāṃ śrayet ||
vināśayanti piśunā na yathā māṃ tathā kṛthāḥ ||
kva māṃsamiti te pṛṣṭā vyāghreṇa kṣudrakāriṇaḥ |
mithyācāraṃ viditvā taṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃsaṃ ca tadgṛhe |
śuddhāya tasmai bhṛtyāya vimohātputra mā krudhaḥ ||
bahavaḥ saṃhatā dhūrtāḥ saṃmataṃ sacivaṃ navam |
svarūpaṃ vikṛto dveṣṭi śūraṃ bhīrurbudhaṃ jaḍaḥ |
kulīnaṃ hīnajanmā ca duḥśīlā ca pativratām ||
guṇavāniti saṃsatsu yaḥ stutaḥ sādhubhiḥ purā |
vane kalevaraṃ tyaktvā tridivaṃ prayayau kṛtī ||
āsthāya vaitasīṃ vṛttiṃ deśakālau samīkṣya ye |
na santi tiṣṭhantyuccairvā na te yānti parābhavam ||
sāgaraḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ purā papraccha kautukāt |
ete viśanti māṃ vṛkṣā hṛtāḥ kūlaṃkaṣairjalaiḥ |
vetasaṃ na tu paśyāmi kasmādatra taṭodbhavam ||
hantuṃ na śakyāste vṛkṣā mahaughairvinamanti ye |
mene ca vaitasīṃ vṛttiṃ śreyase deśakālayoḥ ||
pāhi pāhīti tenoktaḥ sa muniḥ karuṇānidhiḥ |
sa viṣaṇṇo munigirā babhūva śarabhaḥ kṣaṇāt ||
sa jātadarpaḥ sahasā taṃ muniṃ hantumudyayau ||
athāsya vacasā rudraḥ prayayau daṇḍatāṃ svayam |
sa munibhyo dadau te .pi dikpatibhyo kṣupāya te |
labhante śāśvataṃ vīrā yaśaḥ svargaṃ ca bhūmipāḥ ||
trayī trātā tato dharmaṃ bhajate tyaktakilbiṣaḥ |
duryodhanaḥ purā pitre dyūte kāmaṃ nyavedayat ||
na hi śīlavataḥ kiṃcidvidyate bhuvi durlabham ||
videśeṣu dhanaṃ vidyā vyasaneṣu dhanaṃ matiḥ |
paraloke dhanaṃ dharmaḥ śīlaṃ tu nikhilaṃ dhanam ||
śṛṇoti vidyā viduṣāṃ kavīnāṃ saṃśaye vacaḥ ||
sarvaṃ dehi nijaṃ mahyaṃ śīlaṃ śīlavatāṃ vara ||
tasmai tvayā vitīrṇaṃ hi śīlaṃ śīlavibhūṣaṇa ||
yātaṃ vittaṃ ca tanmūlaṃ balaṃ caitannibandhanam ||
śīlāśrayāṃ śriyaṃ viddhi māmapi prasthitāṃ vibho ||
āśā viphalatāṃ nītā sā tena mama saṃvṛtā ||
nivartante kathaṃ nāma kathyatāṃ me pitāmaha ||

column3: munistaṃ vṛṣabho nāma babhāṣe sa smitānanaḥ ||
na vidyate janaḥ kaścidāśayā yo na hīyate |
na ca paśyāmi taṃ loke yācakaṃ yo .bhimanyate ||
putre mṛte vā naṣṭe vā piturekātmajasya vā |
āśā dahati gātrāṇi sā kṛśāpi mahīyasī ||
sthāvire jīrṇakāyānāṃ tāḥ kṛśā api duḥsahāḥ ||
kośamūlaṃ balaṃ rājñāṃ tasminkṣīṇe yathā tathā |
tūrṇaṃ varteta sāmnā vā tyaktātmā vāraṇaṃ vrajet |
na tathā varjayantyārād dhanahīnaṃ yathā janam ||
na tajjagati nāmāsti yad anākramyam āpadām |
ityarthitau tena yadā tau vimohānna jagmatuḥ |
dīrghadarśī tadā pūrvaṃ svayaṃ prāyātsaraḥ param ||
alakṣito yayau tūrṇaṃ prāptajño dhīmatāṃ varaḥ ||
bahūnāṃ gocaraṃ yāto vairiṇāṃ viṣame sthitaḥ |
tau dṛṣṭvā balinau bhītaḥ samprāpte prāṇasaṃśaye |
kālena tasmācchetsyāmi pāśaṃ te mitratāṃ gataḥ ||
yāto vyādho nirāśaśca mārjāre vidrute drutam ||
ahaṃ sa te paraṃ mitram upakāravaśīkṛtaḥ |
gamyatāṃ sa gataḥ kālo na bhūmirvañcaneṣvaham ||
bilaṃ tatyāja kālena dṛṣṭaṃ dhūrtena śatruṇā ||
svaputraṃ rājaputraṃ ca bālye .pi balinau vyadhāt ||
kopaḥ sāmyādapakrānto mā gamaḥ putri pūtane ||
dhiktaṃ kudeśaḥ yatrātmā na śete .śaṅkitaḥ sukham |
pravādaḥ kila satyo .yaṃ yadātmārthe mahīṃ tyajet ||
iti bruvāṇā sā rājñā prārthitāpi punaḥ punaḥ |
rājñā śatruṃtapākhyena vṛttiṃ nītiṃ ca bhūbhujām |
janaṃ viśvasayed vācā śaucaṃ dambhena darśayet |
pragāṇaiḥ śapathaiḥ śāstraiḥ śatruṃ seveta śambaraiḥ ||
āśāṃ nighnair nimittaiśca hetubhiśca tathā vadet ||
arthamāno .pi sa yadā tato lobhena kiṃcana ||
tadā kṛcchrāṃ daśāṃ yātaḥ papāta bhuvi mūrchitaḥ |
sa saktikāṃ snāyutantrīṃ lambamānāṃ vicintya saḥ ||
eṣa śastreṇa sahasā hanyate yo .tra lambate |
adharmo nāturasyāsti ghoraṃ kṛcchraṃ gatasya ca |
mūlaṃ ca jīvo dharmasya tasminnāpatsu rakṣyate ||
ityukto muninā vṛddhaḥ samutthāya jagāda saḥ ||
na vārayāmi te māṃsaṃ vitarāmi na te svayam ||
yasmiṃstapaśca satyaṃ ca svajñānaṃ ca pratiṣṭhitam |
ityuktvā tāṃ samādāya yayau tūrṇaṃ śvajāghanīm |
kapotī tacca śuśrāva baddhā vyādhena pañjare ||
sā tamūce sukṛtino na prayānti viṣaṇṇatām |
pūjāṃ vidhatsva śītārtaḥ śaraṇaṃ hyeṣa vāñchati ||
sa tyaktvā kūṭayantrāṇi samutpāṭya ca pañjaram |
dāvānale tanuṃ tyaktvā lubdhako .pi divaṃ yayau ||

column3: vyavasāyena buddhyā ca niścayena ca dehinaḥ |
imāmavasthāṃ paryante ko nāma na gamiṣyati ||
mā tiṣṭhata ciraṃ ghore śmaśāne pretabāndhavāḥ |
aho nu dāruṇā yūyaṃ tyaktvā gacchanti ye sutam |
kiṃ vo bhayaṃ śmaśāne .sminyāto .staṃ na divākaraḥ |
gṛdhro jagāda citraṃ vo jambukasya girā bhramaḥ ||
snehena pātajīvasya śiśoḥ kiṃ yāta mūḍhatām ||
vanaṃ vrajata vairāgyāttapaḥ kuruta vā mahat |
anyena vartmanā putraḥ pitā cānyena gacchati |
kriyate kiṃ vicāro .sti na kālasya pramāthinaḥ ||
mṛtaḥ pralāpaṃ bāṣpaṃ ca na śṛṇoti na paśyati ||
vatsarāṇāṃ sahasraṃ me sāgraṃ jātasya vartate |
santaḥ śokāmaye nṝṇāṃ na praśaṃsanti bheṣajam ||
kṣaṇena hi na gīryante sahasrāṇi bhavādṛśām |
vapuṣāṃ jīvitānāṃ ca gatānām āgamaḥ kutaḥ ||
divā gṛdhrasya bhojyaṃ yadrātrau gomāyukasya tat ||
śatāyuṣaṃ skandavarātte yayuḥ prāpya taṃ sutam |
papraccha nāradaḥ prītyā taṃ yadṛcchāgato muniḥ |
manye tava paraṃ mittraṃ vāyuryenāsi rakṣyase |
citraṃ mune na jānīṣe bale tulyo na me .nilaḥ ||
śvo draṣṭāsīti taṃ vṛkṣaṃ samabhyetya tadābravīt ||
aho nu dhanyamantro .si buddhyā tvaṃ rakṣitastaro |
lobhe eva mahatpāpaṃ jñānameva paraṃ mahaḥ |
dama eva parā śāntistapa eva paraṃ padam ||
brahmahā dvādaśa samāḥ kapālāṅko vrataṃ caret |
svayaṃbhūr bhagavān khaḍgo dhātrā dhyātaḥ samāyayau ||
tena niṣkaṇṭakaṃ kṛtvā rudro raudreṇa tejasā |
taṃ khaḍgaṃ lebhire bhūpā manuprabhṛtayaḥ kramāt |
śrutveti mandiraṃ pārtho gatvā bhīṣmagiraḥ smaran |
sauhārdaṃ kena na calediti pṛṣṭo .bravīcca saḥ ||
kārtikyāṃ sa hi dātṝṇāṃ dhuryo dāsyati te dhanam |
hataṃ tena bakaṃ jñātvā nijagrāha tamutkaṭam |
jaghāna pāpe pāpānāṃ niḥśaṅkaṃ ramate manaḥ ||
dharmiṣṭhā iva yasyāgre sa kṛtaghno vicāryatām ||
sa tena pṛṣṭaḥ provāca śṛṇu senajitaṃ nṛpam |
mamāyamiti mugdhānāṃ na sa teṣāṃ na tasya te ||
column5: ayaṃ so .ham ayam nāhaṃ vibhāgam iti saṃtyaja |
column9: ayaṃ so .ham ayaṃ nāham iti kṣīṇā vikalpanāḥ |

column3: naṣṭaṃ śocanti duḥkhārtā jantavaḥ sukhinaḥ kadā ||
avaśyaṃ viprayogo hi taiḥ paraiśca nṛṇāṃ sadā ||
ślāghyāya śreyase karma yadi kālaḥ pratīkṣate ||
mṛtyunā yasya sauhārdaṃ yo na vettyāyuṣo .vadhim |
nave vayasi bhogārhe naveṣu vibhaveṣu ca |
navoḍheṣu ca dāreṣu hriyate mṛtyunā janaḥ ||
sukhamāste sukhaṃ śete sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate |
column5: sukhaṃ hy avamataḥ śete sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate |
column9: sukham āste sukhaṃ śete sukham āyāti yāti ca |

column3: aho nu citravarṇāṅkau mama vatsatarau priyau |
alabdhaṃ vāñchatāṃ vittaṃ labdhaṃ ca parirakṣatām |
naṣṭaṃ ca śocatāṃ puṃsāṃ kadā duḥkhaṃ nivartate ||
adhunā lobhamunmūlya spṛhāṃ dūre nirasya ca |
tyāgo hi hanti vyasanaṃ tathā hi janakaḥ purā |
keyaṃ ślāghyatarā vṛttiḥ ko vāyaṃ vibhavo dhiyaḥ |
kṣayodayeṣu bhūtānāṃ na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ bhaje ||
āyuṣāṃ vibhavānāṃ ca bhāvānāṃ ca svabhāvataḥ |
dhanyā manuṣyāḥ saṃsāre yaiḥ svahastena bhujyate |
aho dhanyo .si yannākhurna maṇḍūko na kukkuṭaḥ |
na pukkaso na cāṇḍālo na kuṣṭhī na jaḍo .si vā ||
na tyajāmi tanuṃ pāpā yonayaḥ santyato .dhikāḥ ||
jīvaśca kīdṛśo dehe sa ca yātaḥ kva tiṣṭhati ||
prātaḥ prabuddho vijane malaṃ tyaktvā śuciḥ sadā ||
devapūjārato hotā dātā maunī ca bhojane |
yo naraḥ sa sadācāraḥ prāpnoti padamuttamam ||
svargaspṛhā na me kācid dyaurmahī ca same mama ||
na vāñchā na ca me dveṣaḥ svarge .pyastyavaśaṃ mayā |
ityukte tena bhagavānyamo mṛtyuśca tāṃ bhuvam |
sa taṃ jāpakamabhyetya babhāṣe tejasāṃ nidhim |
gṛhāṇa me dhanaṃ vipra pātraṃ tvatsadṛśo .sti kaḥ ||
dattaṃ mayā punargrāhyaṃ netyuvāca tathā paraḥ ||
uvāca dīyamānaṃ yo na gṛhṇāsi jito .tha saḥ ||
athābravīnnṛpaṃ viprastvaṃ na gṛhṇāsi kiṃ mama |
tataḥ svarge sa vibudhe prāpte sa brahmaṇi svayam |
phalaṃ svargaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ bhīṣmaḥ pṛṣṭo .bravītpunaḥ ||
jñānena gṛhyate jñānaṃ gajeneva vane gajaḥ |
tacchuṣyati virāgeṇa yeṣāṃ te paramaṃ gatāḥ ||
sahajo .ntaḥsthito hantuṃ niḥśeṣaṃ ca na śakyate ||
avyayaṃ paramaṃ cakraṃ buddhiśceti paraṃ mahat ||
tyāgā evaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ muktānāṃ nyastakarmaṇām |
yairdṛṣṭaste na lipyante paṅke śaśikarā iva ||
ityākarṇya vaco rājā janako mithilāṃ purā |
kiṃ tapo vā na vetyetadupavāsādikaṃ vratam |
naraḥ karmaphale kartā kiṃ na vetti kṣamābhujā |
śrutveti daityastaṃ prāha śakra kiṃ katthase vṛthā |
na hi śokaḥ sukhabhraṃśe kartavyo vṛddhasevibhiḥ |
papraccha gatvā brahmāṇaṃ naṣṭe vairocane purā ||
yo babhūva jagannāthaḥ sa baliḥ kvādya vartate ||
śūnyāgāre kharo bhūtvā bhraṣṭaiśvaryo baliḥ sthitaḥ ||
tuṣāśinaṃ baliṃ ko vā vipadbhirnaiva pīḍyate ||
tvamimāṃ gatimāpannaḥ kathaṃ śocyāṃ na śocasi ||
athavā yānti cetāṃsi mahatāṃ saha bhūtibhiḥ ||
api smarasi kiṃ daitya bhāsvatastava śāsanāt |
kiṃ na viplāvayantyetā hariṇyaḥ śīghragāḥ kṣaṇam |
āyuḥ kenākṣayaṃ labdhaṃ viyogaḥ kasya vā priyaḥ |
śrīvihīnaṃ purā śakro namuciṃ nāma dānavam |
karmāyattau na kartā tvaṃ kālaprāptamidaṃ bhaja ||
kālo na yāti yāsyanti sahasrāṇi bhavādṛśām |
gantā tvamapi kālena kiṃ dhairyeṇa vikatthase ||
śrūyante vihitāste te kiṃ vṛthā śakra mādyasi ||
kiṃtu na kṣamate kālo velevābdherbalaṃ mama ||
sa tamūce kālavaśaṃ tvaṃ yathāttha tathaiva tat ||
tadā tvaṃ dāruṇaiḥ pāśairmuktaḥ svāsthyaṃ gamiṣyasi ||
surāṇāṃ sadma sādhūnāṃ samprāptā tava cāntikam ||
āyattāḥ patayaḥ strīṇāṃ śaṇṭīnām adya tatpare |
gṛhe teṣāṃ na vīkṣante hāsakeliratāḥ striyaḥ ||
iti bruvāṇāṃ tāṃ śakraḥ prāpya prāyāttriviṣṭapam |
na hṛṣyanti na śocanti santaḥ saṃtoṣanirbharāḥ ||
mānāvamānayostulyā na snigdhā na ca vairiṇaḥ |
kālasya ca gatiṃ bhīṣmo babhāṣe viśvatattvavit ||
sargasthitiṃ ca kālaṃ ca yacca kṛtyaṃ dvijanmanām ||
śrutveti bhīṣmaṃ papraccha ya ete pṛthivīśvarāḥ |
yātā mṛtyuvaśaṃ teṣāṃ ko mṛtyuriti pāṇḍavaḥ ||
uvāca tāṃ tato brahmā tvaṃ śanaiḥ saṃhara prajāḥ |
tacchrutvā dāruṇaṃ dhātuḥ kṛpayā netrajaṃ jalam |
nijaṃ jagrāha pāṇibhyāṃ nindantī janma duḥkhitā ||
kathaṃ tava sutā deva ghore karmaṇi madvidhā |
yogyā bandhuviyuktānāṃ na sahe duḥkhināṃ giraḥ ||
ityuktvā vipulaṃ cakre duṣkaraṃ vividhaṃ tapaḥ |
bhaviṣyanti janāntāya tvāṃ na jñāsyanti mohitāḥ ||
iti mṛtyuḥ purā sṛṣṭvā brahmaṇā sarvasaṃhṛtiḥ |
mā śucaḥ pṛthivīpāla sā hi kaṃ nopasarpati ||
śaśaṃsa sāraṃ dharmasya satyaṃ parahitaṃ tathā ||
gatirdharmasya vividhā sūkṣmā jñātuṃ na śakyate |
iti śrutvā samanviṣya gatvā vārāṇasīṃ muniḥ |
ahiṃsā paramo yajñaḥ puṇyairyaṣṭuṃ sa śakyate |
gītaṃ vicaravnunā pūrvaṃ dharme .smin eva bhūbhujā |
pūjyo hi bhagavānviṣṇuḥ so .dbhiḥ puṣpaiśca tuṣyati ||
glāniṃ śarīraṃ nāyāti yathā na maraṇaṃ bhavet |
ciraṃ vicārya karmāṇi sa karoti yadā tadā |
mātaraṃ guruvākyaṃ ca vimarśo hi śubhāspadam ||

column9: ke praṇamyā iti punaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śāntanavo .bravīt |

column3: nivṛtte ca pravṛtte ca dharme dharmavidāṃ vara ||
nivṛttaṃ ca pravṛttaṃ ca dharmaṃ pṛṣṭo .tha bhūbhujā |
nahuṣasya purā saure sattre gāṃ yūpasaṃgatām |
yajeta dadyādityeṣā na śrutā kiṃ śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ |
niśamya kuryātko nāma na dharmopārjane matim ||
dehī dehaviyoge svaṃ brahma gacchati nirguṇaḥ ||
anirviṇṇaḥ prahṛṣṭaśca jñātā maunī ca mucyate |
sa vijñāyācyutaṃ devaṃ prayayau paramāṃ gatim |
so .yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃbandhī tava pāṇḍava ||
rājñā vṛtrakathāṃ pṛṣṭaḥ punaḥ prāha pitāmahaḥ |
brahmaṇā duḥsahaḥ so .tha vinyastaḥ kila bhāgaśaḥ |
teṣu teṣūtkaṭo yatnādekaḥ ko nu saheta tam ||
meṣeṣu pittabhedaṃ ca hikkāśvāsaṃ śukeṣu ca |
janmanyante vivāhe ca manuṣyeṣu jvaraṃ tathā |
jānannapi na kurvīta kauṭilyaṃ na ca viśvaset ||
na hi pātayituṃ śaktaḥ sukhena bhavapādapam ||
tyajeti viṣasaṃkāśaṃ ko nāma vacanaṃ pibet ||
cīnāṃśuke valkale ca samānaḥ kila mucyate ||
atha śukrakathāṃ pṛṣṭo rājñā prāha suravrataḥ |
papau sa codare śaṃbhorbabhrāma vipule ciram ||
tataḥ sa śukradvāreṇa nirgataḥ śukratāṃ yayau |
satīsaṃrakṣito lebhe na ca vai pūrvavatsthitim ||
na caratyavaṭe tasya karmaṇo .pi sukhaṃ sadā ||
ratyai bhogā vimūḍhānāṃ sā duḥkhāya viyoginām |
dagdhāḥ krodhena śocanti krodhāndhā nipatanti ca |
tiṣṭhangṛhe ko nu muktaḥ pārtheneti suravrataḥ |
pṛṣṭo babhāṣe sulabhā yadūce janakaṃ purā ||
tataḥ sukhoṣitā tatra bhuktottaram upetya sā |
naikāntavāsitā śāntyai na gehaṃ bandhanāya ca |
antaḥpraveśaḥ kimayaṃ tvayā me yogataḥ kṛtaḥ |
sarvāṅgasaṅgaṃ kuruṣe satī bhūtvā na lajjase |
kāraṇaṃ brūhi subhage na mithyā vaktumarhasi ||
sā babhāṣe praviṣṭāpi chāyeva purataḥ sthitā |
kāsi kasya kuto vā tvaṃ yadevamabhidhīyate |
saṃghātastattvacakrasya so .yaṃ kasya na kasya vā ||
dīpasyevārciṣo yātā yasya so .yaṃ kutaḥ katham ||
vikalpaṃ pṛcchato naiṣā muktatā tava śobhate |
dhanaṃ kośe gajāḥ śāle svagṛheṣu ca mantriṇaḥ |
akaṅkaṇam ahāraṃ ca śayyāyāṃ vartate vapuḥ |
nivasāmi kṣapāmekāṃ kā nu te nṛpate kṣatiḥ ||
tatkathaṃ nṛpate muktaḥ sparśaṃ vetsi sarāgavat ||
tarau latā tatra puṣpaṃ tasminṣaṭcaraṇā iva ||
sa tvaṃ pravṛttivimukho na ca prāpto nivṛttatām |
triśaṅkuriva madhyastho na divaṃ na bhuvaṃ śritaḥ ||
na hṛṣṭo nāpahṛṣṭaśca tūṣṇīṃ nabha ivābhavat ||
capaleṣu ca bhāveṣu tāṭasthyaṃ putra nocitam ||
svayamutpādite magnaḥ kṣudraḥ ko nāma mucyate ||
tasya śukraṃ papātāśu śukībhūtāṃ vilokya tām |
śukraḥ kamaṇḍaluṃ yasmai dyauśca daṇḍājinaṃ dadau ||
upadeśaṃ pituḥ prāpya tadgirā janakaṃ yayau |
nināya rātriṃ prātaśca nṛpo draṣṭuṃ tamāyayau ||
spṛhāgranthiṃ puro muktvā tato rāgaṃ tataḥ śucam |
yukto vimiśratāṃ yāti śaileṣu salileṣu ca ||

column5: sumantuṃ jaiminiṃ pailaṃ vaiśampāyanam eva ca |

column3: adhīyānaḥ paraṃ brahma vyastaṃ vyāsena dhīmatā ||
atha pravāti pavane kṛte cādhyayane śukaḥ |
sa eva vāyurniḥśvāso vahatsveteṣu no paṭhet |
krodhaśca mṛtyurityetadyo vetti na sa śocati |
bahu manyeta na dhanaṃ saṃtoṣaṃ śamamāsthitaḥ ||
na vismayaṃ na saṃtāpaṃ vānurāgaṃ bhajeta ca ||
anicchatāṃ saṃtatiṃ ca jāyante bahavaḥ sutāḥ |
labhante putrakāmāśca pātaṃ vā naiva vā sutam ||
nirakṣepaḥ sa gatvātha samāruhya gireḥ śiraḥ |
niḥśabdaḥ sa same deśe sarvajñaḥ samupāviśat ||
raviṃ vāyuṃ jalaṃ bhūmiṃ praviśya gaganaṃ tathā |
tyaktvā rajaḥ saptavidhaṃ sattvaṃ cotsṛjya kevalam ||
nirvyañjanaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca brāhmaṃ tejaḥ samāviśat ||
līne tataḥ pare dhāmni śuke tanayavatsalaḥ |
eka eva paro devaḥ ko vedya iti bhūbhujā |
prayayau ca paraṃ draṣṭuṃ kāraṇaṃ viṣṇumavyayam ||
oṃ jaya ajita avyaya aprameya ananta acyuta aparimita acala acintya apratihata abhava mahāvibhava niratiśaya nirañjana nirlepa
taṃ viśvavyāpinaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyo yayau muniḥ ||
nāgaṃ dadarśa taṃ prāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā papraccha kautukam ||
rathasya cakraṃ vāreṇa balena vahatā mayā ||
karairgṛhītvā tyajati payo bhūmau praviśya ca |
āmantrya pannagaṃ vipro vidhāya cyavanaṃ gurum |
jāyeta mādṛśaḥ ko .nyaḥ sadṛśo mama duṣkṛtī |
bandhūnāṃ tvatpradhānānāṃ yaḥ kṣaye sākṣitāṃ gataḥ ||
mlāpitaṃ rājyalubdhena sa eva nihato bhavān ||
daṣṭaṃ dadarśa sarpeṇa gatāsuṃ kānane purā ||
ayaṃ putrasya te hantā mayā baddho bhujaṅgamaḥ |
brūhi yāvatkṣipāmyenaṃ vahnau śastreṇa hanmi vā ||
upayānti svayaṃ mṛtyuṃ hantā kaścinna kasyacit ||
tasmādasminna kopo me kutaḥ kope .pi nigrahaḥ |
jaḍa vyādha vimuñcainaṃ hataḥ kālena me sutaḥ ||
hato .yaṃ mṛtyunā bālo yo māṃ preritavānsvayam |
kāraṇena tvayā sarpa nīto .yaṃ mṛtyunā śiśuḥ ||
na hi nāma svayaṃ kaścitkareṇākṛṣya mṛtyunā |
nīto bhavadvidhā yāvadyātāḥ sarpa na hetutām |
nāhamasya śiśorhantā na cāyaṃ bhujago jaḍa |
jāyate vardhate bhuṅkte prasūte modate punaḥ |
jīryate kṣīyate vāpi na jantuḥ karmaṇā vinā ||
iti kālena kathite sarpaṃ tatyāja lubdhakaḥ |
pṛthagyayuśca te sarve naṣṭaśokā ca gautamī ||
taṃ narmadā nadī dṛṣṭvā snātaṃ kamalalocanam |

column5: tām uvāca tato rājā kanyāṃ rājīvalocanām |
column9: tasya jajñe tadā nadyāṃ kanyā rājīvalocanā |

column3: nirdhanāvajñayā tasmai tāṃ yadā na dadau nṛpaḥ |
svapne jagāda taṃ mahyaṃ kanyaiṣā dīyatāmiti ||
sutā moghavato rājñaḥ kāntāṃ moghavatīṃ yuvā |
sa lebhe kṣīṇavāṇasya navā śaktiṃ manobhuvaḥ ||
tayā saha kurukṣetre gṛhī dharmapade sthitaḥ |
ātithyaṃ kriyatāṃ subhru rājaputri mama tvayā |
yadi dharmaḥ pramāṇaṃ te tanmāṃ bhaja sulocane ||
dharmyaṃ tataḥ sā vacanaṃ smṛtvā bhartuḥ pativratā |
sā bhartrā sahasāhūtā na ca prāptā dvijāntikam |
prāptā nādyāpi śayanaṃ prāptaśca tvaṃ gṛhādhipaḥ |
adhṛṣṭā tejasā ceyaṃ tvadbhāryā kena laṅghyate |
bhaviṣyati kṣitau puṇyā nityaṃ tvāṃ cānuyāsyati ||
sa ca vīro divaṃ prāpa sabhāryaśca sudarśanaḥ ||
tadgirā vyatyayaṃ cakre vṛkṣayoḥ pāyase tathā ||
tacchrutvā duḥkhasaṃtaptā yayāce sā muniṃ punaḥ |
kṣatrācārastu me pautro mā putra iti mūrchitā ||
sthitaṃ tatra śukaṃ vīkṣya śakro .bhyetya tamabravīt ||
kiṃ tvayāyaṃ śritaḥ śākhī tyaktvainaḥ cara nirvṛtaḥ ||
yatroṣitaṃ ca bhuktaṃ ca vihṛtaṃ ca yathāsukham |
ānṛśaṃsyātsa ca śukaḥ prayayau paramāṃ gatim |
anuptabīje kṛṣṭe .pi daivaṃ kṣetre karoti kim |
pauruṣaṃ karma puruṣairyathā yatra yadā kṛtam |
tathā tatra tadābhyetya visaṃvādo na dṛśyate ||
pratiśrutya mayā pūrvaṃ na vitīrṇaṃ dvijanmane |
asavarṇopadeṣṭāraḥ kiṃ na syuḥ śreyasāṃ padam |
viprā iti punaḥ pṛṣṭo rājñā śāntanavo .bravīt ||
purā vane śūdramuner brahmarṣir abhavat sakhā |
sadā jahāsa taccāsau nṛpaṃ papraccha lajjitaḥ ||
śrutvaitatsahasā smṛtvā tapase sa yayau muniḥ |
pṛṣṭaḥ prāha hareragre rukmiṇīṃ śrīḥ purābhyadhāt ||
jitendriyeṣu vīreṣu prītyā me śāśvatī sthitiḥ ||
sparśādhikyaṃ kimu strīṇāṃ nṛṇāṃ vā saṃgameṣviti ||
kṛtvā sainyakṣayaṃ ghoraṃ niḥśeṣāḥ pralayaṃ yayuḥ ||
bheditā nādhunā vairamāpanne tvayi me nṛpa ||

column5: śṛṇu śakra mahābhāga sarvam etad vadāmi te |

column3: strīrūpaṃ tu parityajya puruṣo bhava madvarāt ||
strīṇāṃ sparśeṣu yā prītiḥ sā puṃbhirlabhyate kutaḥ ||
kāmasya sāraṃ surataṃ ratasya sparśāmṛtaṃ tacca sulocanānām |
sarvātmanā nirvṛtijīvaśūnyaṃ bhave bhave jīvitameva kāntāḥ ||
harireva haraṃ vetti haro vetti tathā harim |
putrārthinī jāmbavatī priyā provāca māṃ purā |
athābravīnmāṃ jananī vane putra payaḥ kutaḥ |
tenālaṃ surarājyena kiṃ mokṣeṇāpi tena me |
tataḥ stuto mayā śaṃbhurmahyaṃ kṣīrodadhiṃ dadau |
labhasva tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tasyātmā tvaṃ sa vā tava ||
trinetraṃ prayataṃ nāmnāṃ tuṣṭāva daśabhiḥ śataiḥ ||
sthāṇo sthirasthite śaṃbho śarva bhāno varaprada |
sa tāmālokya sumukhīṃ yayāce sotsuko munim ||
ityuktaḥ sa vadanyena pratasthe tāṃ diśaṃ śanaiḥ ||
dinānte so .tha tāḥ prāha yāntu sarvāḥ svamālayam |
uvāca bhogasaṃkalpabhaṅgaṃ mā me kṛthāḥ prabho ||
na te doṣo .sti matsaṅge tyājyā naiva tu yoṣitaḥ |
durgamaṃ nābhijānanti gaṇayanti na ca śramam ||
ityuktvā nirvikāraṃ taṃ sā dṛṣṭvā punarabravīt ||
adhunā tāṃ vadanyasya gatvā prāpnuhi kanyakām ||
rājñā gatiṃ ca tīrthaṃ ca pṛṣṭaḥ śāntanavo .bravīt ||
teṣu teṣu ca kāleṣu deśeṣu ca yathāvidhi ||
bhāgīrathīṃ kauśikīṃ ca rāmaṇīṃ narmadāṃ tathā |
prayāgaṃ nandikuṇḍaṃ ca vipāśaṃ mānasaṃ saraḥ ||
na te deśā na te śailā na te janapadāḥ kṣitau |
patākā yasya puṇyasya jāhnavī na vibhāvyate ||
smṛtvā vavande sānandaḥ puṇyāṃ mandākinīṃ muniḥ ||
pṛṣṭo devavrataḥ prāha brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ nṛpa ||
gardabhī vyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ duḥkhāduvāca tam |
vahainamiti tacchrutvā priyaḥ papraccha tāṃ punaḥ ||
tayā niveditāṃ jātiṃ nijāṃ jñātvā sa duḥkhitaḥ |
meroḥ śṛṅgādiva śvabhre patito vilalāpa saḥ ||
pitre nivedya tatpāpaṃ mātuḥ sa tapase vanam |
tato gatvā gayāṃ cakre sahasrābdaṃ paraṃtapaḥ ||
chandodeva iti khyātaḥ sa mataṅgābhidhaḥ purā |
tadvadeti punaḥ pṛṣṭo rājñā prāha pitāmahaḥ ||
tacchrutvā kṣatriyo neha kaścitsarve dvijā vayam |
ke praṇamyā iti punaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śāntanavo .bravīt |
havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca vahati kṛṣṇamityāha nāradaḥ ||
jaye balaṃ bhaye rakṣā bheṣajaṃ vyasanāmaye |
strī satī strīsvabhāvaṃ ca mādṛśī vaktumarhati |
apyanviṣṭā na labhyante saṃtyaktā na tyajanti ca |
rāgiṇyo .pi priyaṃ ghnanti ko hi tāṃ vetti yoṣitam ||
na kulena na mānena na dhanena na sevayā |
suveśaṃ subhagaṃ kāntaṃ tyaktvā paricitaṃ ciram |
yantritāḥ svajanenāpi tadā sādhyā na yoṣitaḥ ||
nṛtyanti śocanti patanti yānti hasanti gāyanti vadanti yacca |
tāḥ striyo lolamatayaḥ kathaṃ rakṣyā narairiti |
jñātvā ruciṃ śarīrāntaḥ praviśa tvaṃ samīravat |
dadarśa mithunaṃ ṣaṭ ca devinaḥ kitavān pathi ||
ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ ca kitavāste nṛṇāṃ karmasākṣiṇaḥ ||
na śakyā rakṣituṃ nāryo rakṣitā ca tvayā ruciḥ |
ityevaṃ rakṣitā pūrvaṃ vipulena guroḥ priyā |
darśane sahavāse ca satāṃ pṛṣṭo mahībhujā |
māhātmyaṃ ca gavāṃ bhīṣmaḥ sarvajñaḥ punarabravīt ||
taṃ vīkṣya kampitāḥ sarve sahasā jālajīvinaḥ |
dayitāḥ sahavāsānme matsyā yūyaṃ ca darśanāt ||
tataḥ svayaṃ sa nṛpatiḥ pūjāmādāya satvaraḥ |

column21: evaṃ koṭisahasreṇa śaṅkūnāṃ ca śatena ca |

column3: gavi jāto dvijavaro babhāṣe dhīmatāṃ varaḥ ||
tato muniḥ samutthāya maunī gatvā manojavaḥ |
tato nānāvidhaṃ bhojyaṃ rājayogyaṃ svayaṃ kṛtam |
ityuktvā dampatī dhṛtvā tau rathe vicacāra saḥ |
muninā vihitairmohaṃ dampatī tau na jagmatuḥ ||
sarvaṃ sūte vasumatī dhatte ca nikhilaṃ jagat |
rājñā mameyaṃ prāgdattā hṛteyaṃ dasyunā paraḥ |
nṛgo jagāma tridivaṃ tyaktvā tāṃ kṛkalāsatām ||
putraṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntakrodho muniḥ śanaiḥ |
tataḥ svapnotthita iva prāptajīvo muneḥ sutaḥ |
nivāsārthaṃ purā gāvaḥ prārthitā bahuśaḥ śriyā |
tyaktā nindyā bhaviṣyāmi tasmādyāce punaḥ punaḥ ||
tasmādetāḥ paraṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ nāstyataḥ param ||
tejo hi paramaṃ putra kāñcanaṃ jātavedasaḥ ||
piṇḍo mayā kuśeṣveva taṃ vilokya samarpitaḥ |
tuṣṭastadā me janakaḥ svapne provāca māmidam ||
kanakaṃ dehi viprebhyo dānānāmuttamaṃ hi tat ||
jāmadagnyaḥ purā rāmaḥ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyaṃ jagat |
gaṅgāyāṃ nihitaḥ sāpi nidadhe taṃ girestaṭe ||
na teṣāṃ pitaraḥ śocyāstrayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca |
varṣāsu vihitaṃ śrāddhaṃ pāyase na sasarpiṣā ||
dāsaḥ paśusakho nāma dāsī caṇḍā ca tadvadhūḥ |
rājye surājñaḥ śaibyasya gatāsuṃ tanayaṃ tataḥ |
yathecchaṃ gṛhyatāṃ mattaḥ sarvaṃ vā vividhaṃ vasu |
etaduktvā parityajya sthālīṃ te kānanaṃ yayuḥ |
agnihotraṃ na vedāśca śāstrakanthā na duḥsahā |
śunaḥsakhoditaṃ nāma punaḥ papraccha sā yadā |
tadā kruddhāstu daṇḍena vidadhustāṃ ca bhasmasāt ||
deyātsa kanyakāṃ yena hatānyatra bisāni naḥ |
sā ca kṛtyā hatā ghoro devo .haṃ tridaśeśvaraḥ ||
indrastu prāha dhanyo .stu sa hṛtaṃ yena puṣkaram ||
sa jāyāṃ vīkṣya madhyāhne kruddhaḥ sūryamudaikṣata ||
araṇye bhavatā yasya śāpamokṣaḥ purā kṛtaḥ ||
tadreṇu tatsthitaṃ cānnaṃ mohānme bhakṣyatāṃ yayau ||
hutvā śarīraṃ caṇḍālaḥ prāpa puṇyaṃ punargatim ||
muneḥ putra iva prītyā sa babhūva mahāgajaḥ ||
taṃ pravṛddhaṃ tathā nāgaṃ svayametya śatakratuḥ |
punaḥ punaryācyamāno muninā sa yadā nṛpaḥ |
na tatyāja gajaṃ darpāttadā taṃ gautamo .vadat ||
nandanti śocantyathavā tatra dāsyasi me gajam ||
yatra mugdhā vidagdhāśca tatra dāsyati me gajam ||
dhanadasya pure ramye merau vā nandane vane |
loke vā dāsyasi gajaṃ na tatra balavānasi ||
nāhaṃ kvacidgamiṣyāmi kva nu dāsyāmi te gajam ||
ityuktvā kuñjaraṃ tasmai dattvā divyāṃ tathā gatim |
svaṃ vapurdarśayitvā ca hasannindro yayau divam ||
dattvā ca vipulaṃ dānaṃ modate puṇyavānsukhī |
sūkaraḥ kṛkavākuśca jambukaḥ śvā sa jāyate ||
gurornikāraṃ kṛtvā ca bhavati śvā tato vṛkaḥ |
cīrī ca lalanasteno dadhihartā tathā bakaḥ |
tāṃ tāṃ tamomayīṃ yoniṃ saṃsaranti śarīriṇaḥ ||
dānena kila śāmyanti dānaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā ko nāma māṃsebhyaḥ spṛhāṃ kuryādarākṣasaḥ ||
asmin api śarīre te rakṣārthaṃ ko .yamāgrahaḥ |
pitroḥ śuśrūṣayā kiṃtu mune jātiṃ smarāmyaham ||
tasmai nṛpapadaṃ vyāso dadau janmāntare kramāt ||
vipro .tha tadgirā bhūtvā sa yayau paramāṃ gatim |
bhuktvā prahṛṣṭaḥ provāca kathānte tapasāṃ nidhiḥ ||
tejaḥ paraṃ tapo nāma divyameva balaṃ tapaḥ |
paśyanti santastapasā jñānaṃ hi tapasaḥ phalam ||
dānātparaṃ na saṃsāre dehināṃ śarma vidyate ||
subhage kena tapasā dānena caritena vā |
nāhaṃ vratairna saṃnyāsairna dānena divaṃ śritā ||
na hi santaḥ praśaṃsanti tapaḥ strīṇāmataḥ param ||
adhikaṃ prīyate kiṃ svit sāmnā dānena vā janaḥ |
purā vane dvijaḥ kaścidgṛhīto rakṣasā balāt |
viraktaḥ svajano yāsi tena vā pariśuṣyasi ||
vyaktaṃ tyāgī daridro .si guṇairnūnaṃ na pūjyase |
prājñasya te na śṛṇvanti sādhurvā vañcyase khalaiḥ ||
mūrkho vā śāstrarasiko mānī hīnakulo .si vā |
duḥkhaṃ svapiṣi manye .haṃ cintayā hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ ||
prītastatyāja taṃ sāmnā ko hi sāntvairna tuṣyati ||
purā himagirau gaurī dhūrjaṭeḥ kila līlayā |
sa sūryaḥ sa ca śītāṃśuḥ so .haṃ sa ca caturmukhaḥ |
nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ munayo yasya gāyanti muktaye ||
udeti somaḥ sūryaśca prayāti ca samīraṇaḥ ||
bhavādṛśā dṛśā yeṣāṃ bhavanti na bhavanti ca ||
ataḥ paraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ prabhāvaṃ keśavo vibhuḥ |
sa bhuktvā pāyasaṃ taptamucchiṣṭena ruṣā jvalan |
rukmiṇīṃ sa rathe kṛtvā babhrāma bahuyojanam |
nirvikāraṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa paruṣāśrayaḥ ||
bhaviṣyati vinā pādau tau niliptau yatastvayā ||
mā gamaḥ putraśokārtyā mohaṃ kālo hi durjayaḥ ||
etaduktvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ stutvā mūrdhnā praṇamya ca |
bhittvā bhīṣmasya mūrdhānaṃ viveśa vimalaṃ nabhaḥ ||
jetā tasyāpi rāmasya nihato .si kathaṃ paraiḥ ||
aho nu tvayi kālena yāte .staṃ yaśasāṃ nidhau |
kā nāma jananī pāpā madvidhānyā bhaviṣyati |
nihataṃ tvādṛśaṃ putraṃ yā śrutvāpi na dīryate ||
aho bata varākeṇa hato bhīṣmaḥ śikhaṇḍinā |
sa yātaḥ paramaṃ dhāma svacchandanidhanaḥ svayam |
aśocyaṃ mā śucaḥ putraṃ ko .nyo jāyeta tadvidhaḥ ||

column3: tṛṣṇātantur visasyeva śuṣyato na tu śuṣyati ||
tasminhate sarvamidaṃ jāyate ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
yogīndro brāhmaṇaḥ ko .sau kvāste vā sā ca tadvadhūḥ ||
tasmin eva layaṃ yāti śvabhre puṣpacayo yathā ||
ahaṃkāraḥ sa manaso līlayā kena bhedyate ||
iti brahmoditaṃ jñānaṃ śiṣyāya guruṇā purā |
ahameva guruḥ pārtha śiṣyaśca tvaṃ samo mama |
tato vihṛtya suciraṃ prītyā kṛṣṇaḥ kirīṭinā |
sa gatvā nṛpamāmantrya dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca sānugam |
āśvāsya kṛṣṇāṃ kuntīṃ ca praṇamyādāya cānujām ||
uttaṅkaṃ tapasāṃ rāśim āluloke muniḥ pathi ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sādaraṃ śauriḥ praṇamya racitāñjaliḥ |
ūce kaccittvayā sāmnā rakṣitaṃ bhārataṃ kulam ||
bhāratānāṃ mune yatnaḥ paraḥ saṃdhau kṛto mayā ||
na jagrāha kṛtāntena daivena ca vimohitaḥ ||
nihatāḥ pārthivāḥ sarve śeṣāḥ pañcaiva pāṇḍavāḥ ||
kiṃtu nārhasi kopena tīvraṃ kartuṃ tapovyayam |
tamo hi duḥsahaṃ ghoraṃ krodho mṛtyuḥ śarīriṇām ||
kiṃ na jānāsi māṃ sarvaṃ sarvavyāpinamavyayam ||
jāne tvāṃ kiṃtu taddivyaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi te vapuḥ |
mune madvacasā śakraḥ sudhāṃ tvāṃ dātumāyayau ||
jalado na sa cāṇḍālo mithyā śaṅkā tavābhavat |
pratyākhyātaḥ sa yanmohānna tadyuktaṃ tvayā kṛtam ||
āsādya paramaṃ jñānaṃ yaḥ purā gurusevayā |
yo dadau gurubhāryāyai kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ca ||
sa gatvā sānujaḥ śailaṃ śrīkaṇṭhadayitaṃ śanaiḥ |
uṣṭrāṇāṃ śakaṭānāṃ ca hayānāṃ kariṇāṃ tathā |
mahiṣāṇāṃ kharāṇāṃ ca puruṣāṇāṃ gavāṃ tathā |
na babhūva tadā saṃkhyā vahatāṃ bhūri kāñcanam ||
tataḥ kuntī subhadrā ca sametya karuṇānidhim |
tāṃ smaran āvadhīdbhūpānsa vijigye tu kevalam ||
pūjāmādāya tanayaṃ namraṃ dṛṣṭvā puraḥ sthitam |
dṛṣṭvā māṃ sāyudhaṃ prāptaṃ sāmnā pratyudyato .si kim |
ityuktaḥ sa tayā dhanvī rathaṃ hemaharidhvajam |
nādo babhūva gagane hā heti tridivaukasām ||
aho bata cirādetya jāyāyā mama mandiram |
tvāṃ prāptaṃ nayanānandaṃ paśyāmi nihataṃ kṣitau ||
tataḥ pradadhyau manasā nāgī saṃjīvanaṃ maṇim |
spṛṣṭo .tha hṛdaye tena jīvitaṃ prāpya phalguṇaḥ |
citrāṅgadā ca sahasā śokaṃ tyaktvā hriyaṃ yayau ||
ko .nyathā tvāṃ raṇe śakto jetuṃ nirjitadhūrjaṭim ||
aho nu saktuprasthena na tulyo .yaṃ mahāmakhaḥ ||
nūnaṃ dānakaṇaḥ śuddhaḥ kṛśo .pi prathate nṛṇām |
kṣutparītaḥ kṣudhākrāntaṃ sa taṃ dṛṣṭvātithiṃ dvijaḥ |
tadbhāryā tatsutaścāsmai tatsnuṣā ca dadau tadā ||
saśarīrā divaṃ prāpuḥ sarve te ślāghyavṛttayaḥ ||
bhrāntasyāpi na saṃjātaḥ ko .pi kānto lavastanau ||
manasaḥ kila vaimalyaṃ paraṃ brahma pracakṣate ||
pasparśa jihvayā śrāddhe dhṛtaṃ hi piṭhire payaḥ ||
na śaśāpa tato bhītaḥ krodhaḥ kampākulo .bhavat ||
tataste pitaraḥ kruddhā yeṣāṃ śrāddhe dhṛtaṃ payaḥ |

column3: taṃ vīkṣya sānujaṃ tatra jātamanyuḥ śatakratum |
na tatra mama vāso .sti vrajāmyeṣa namo .stu te |
yatra me bhrātaraḥ śūrāstatra vāso mamādhunā ||
kṛṣṇā ceyaṃ varārohā mahiṣī vallabhā satī |
ayaṃ mohaḥ prasādo vā viveko nāyamīdṛśaḥ ||
vibudhānāṃ na jānanti ye dharmasya vyatikramam |
ihaivāhaṃ sthito gaccha na me svargeṇa kāraṇam ||
pūjyante yatra durvṛttā viśasyante nu sādhavaḥ |
gatvā vyajijñapatsarvaṃ sa ca tūṣṇīṃ samāyayau |
prāpte surādhipe tatra saha dharmādibhiḥ suraiḥ ||
utsṛjya mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ puṇyāṃ surasabhāṃ yayau ||
maṇḍale ca raveḥ karṇaṃ svayamindreṇa darśitam |
vasuṃ śāntanavaṃ bhīṣmaṃ guruṃ droṇaṃ bṛhaspatim |
yadaṃśā bhuvi ye jātāstāṃśca dṛṣṭvā tadāśrayān |
jahuḥ parasparaṃ kṣatraṃ niḥśeṣā yena bhūrabhūt ||
purā kṣatrakṣayaṃ kṛtvā bhargaśiṣyaḥ sa bhārgavaḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti puṇyaṃ tanmunīnāṃ vacasā kila |
akṣauhiṇyo daśāṣṭau ca tatraiva nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||
ratho gajo narāḥ pañca trayo .śvāḥ pattirucyate |
adṛṣṭaṃ prāpsyasi bhayaṃ na cirāditi abravīt ||
tacchrutvā cakito gatvā muniṃ vavre purohitam |
kṣetre jalaṃ badhāneti sa ca gatvā tathākarot ||
taṃ guruḥ pīvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha kenāsi vartase |
gavyaṃ kṣīraṃ kutaḥ svaṃ te vatsaphenaṃ tadeva ca |
vatsa stutvāśvinau dvau tvaṃ divyaṃ cakṣuravāpnuhi ||
apūpaṃ gurave taṃ ca sāmṛtaṃ sa nyavedayat ||
kadācidatha taṃ dhṛtvā śiṣyaṃ gehe jitendriyam |
kriyāmahīnāṃ tvaṃ kartā nirdiṣṭo guruṇā gṛhe |
uttaṅkena tataḥ pṛṣṭā kiṃ dadāmīti tadvadhūḥ |
mahyaṃ dehīti tacchrutvā pratiśrutya jagāma saḥ ||
tatrāntaḥpuram āsādya kṣatriyāṃ na dadarśa saḥ ||
tām adṛṣṭvā nṛpaṃ prāha tvadbhāryā kiṃ na dṛśyate |
tvaṃ na paśyasi me jāyāmucchiṣṭastāṃ pativratām ||
pauṣyeṇāmantritaḥ śrāddhe dṛṣṭvānnaṃ taṃ śaśāpa saḥ ||
vāraya pratiśāpaṃ me tvamapi kṣmābhṛtāṃ vara ||
tataḥ puraṃdaraṃ stutvā hayārūḍhaṃ dadarśa tam |
te prāpya hṛṣṭastenaiva vājinā prayayau gurum ||
dattvā te gurubhāryāyai guruṃ papraccha kautukāt |
paṭaṃ cakraṃ vayasyaṃ ca naraṃ ca vṛṣavāhanam ||
te hi dhātā vidhātā ca sāsāśrivalayākulam ||
tatkālacakramṛtavaḥ kumārāḥ ṣaṭ ca te sthitāḥ |
ityuttaṅkaḥ samākarṇya guroḥ prāpya varaṃ varam |
provāca kṣatriyā rājannirvairā na padaṃ śriyaḥ ||
papraccha svakulaṃ pūrvaṃ sa ca pṛṣṭo .bhyabhāṣata ||
patyau snānāya niryāte pulomā nāma rākṣasaḥ |
pṛṣṭena vahninā khyātā bhṛgorbhāryeti sa svayam |
tato bhṛguḥ samabhyetya jñātvā dṛṣṭyā ca tatpunaḥ |
adarśanaṃ gataḥ prāpa pratiṣṭhāṃ brahmaṇo varāt ||
dīrghavairaṃ dvijo bhūtvā mā kṛthā bhujagānprati |
kṣatriyasya vrataṃ dhairyaṃ dvijānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ kṛpā ||
tathā hi vahninā dagdhāḥ sarpasatre bhujaṃgamāḥ |
na mannāmnīṃ vinā bhāryāṃ bhajiṣyāmīti sarvadā ||
mātaraṃ kupito dāsyaṃ yāsyasīti śaśāpa saḥ ||
śaśāṅkaṃ kaustubhaṃ lakṣmīṃ sudhāṃ dhanvantariṃ tathā |
sudhāṃ jahāra sahasā taddattāṃ ca papuḥ surāḥ ||
tapo ghorataraṃ cakre yena tāvatti parvasu ||
amṛtotthaṃ bhaginyau taṃ dṛṣṭvāśvaṃ dhavalaṃ pathi |
paṇaṃ dāsyāya cakrāte vivādeneti te tataḥ ||
stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ sa yayau māturantikam ||
mātaraṃ vinatāṃ tārkṣyaḥ prāpya śuśrāva tatkathām |
aluptasaṃdhyaḥ satataṃ na hi jātyā tiraskṛtaḥ ||
svasti te .stu vraja kṣipramiti māturgirā khagaḥ |
bhojanaṃ diśa me tāta na tṛpto .smītyathābhyadhāt ||
abhajyata munivyāptā cañcvādāya sa tāṃ yayau ||
tapasā vālakhilyānāṃ jāto jetā sa vajriṇaḥ |
jahāsālpabalānindraḥ ko vā lakṣmyā na mādyati ||
varaṃ gṛhāṇa matto.pi tamityāha sa pakṣiṇam ||
vāhanaṃ me bhavānbhūyāttārkṣyaḥ prāha tathāstu me ||
svayaṃ tatyāja māno .stu vajrasyeti vihasya saḥ ||
nirjitena surendreṇa sakhyaṃ kṛtvā jagāda tam |
uktveti gatvā bhujagāndattvā tebhyaḥ sudhāṃ khagaḥ |
sudhāṃ kuśeṣu saṃsthāpya snātuṃ yāteṣu bhogiṣu |
kadrūraho na tīkṣṇeti devānāṃ bruvatāṃ giraḥ ||
iti pṛṣṭo yadā kiṃcinnovāca sa munistadā |
śavaṃ bhujagamādhāya skandhe tasya yayau nṛpaḥ ||
atha tattanayaḥ śṛṅgī mahākopī vilokya tam ||
sa dadarśa puro vipraṃ kaśyapaṃ viṣamantriṇam |
ahaṃ sa takṣako nāma mā jetuṃ kaḥ pragalbhate ||
taṃ rakṣasi narendraṃ cenmayā dagdhaṃ mahādrumam |
saśākhapuṣpapatraṃ ca cakre mantreṇa taṃ dvijaḥ ||
prasādya pradadau bhūri prāpya vipraśca tadyayau ||
kāladaṣṭaṃ nṛpaṃ jñātvā yāte divyadṛśi dvije |
taṃ sametya mahīpālaṃ channāḥ svastīti vādinaḥ |
phalāni ca dadustasmai puṣpāṇi ca kuśaiḥ saha ||
sureśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāte mantrakṛṣṭe ca takṣake ||
iti bruvāṇe bhūpāle khaṃ prāpte ca śatakratau ||
astīkaṃ vāsukiḥ prāha svasrīyaṃ rakṣa māmiti |

column3: tato mantrabalāt traste takṣake vajriṇā saha |
astīko .yaṃ nṛpaṃ prāpya svastipūrvāṃ stutiṃ vyadhāt |

vidhāya dikṣu nīhāraṃ bheje tāṃ hariṇekṣaṇām ||
yo jāta eva sarvāṅgavedavit prayayau vanam ||
jātaḥ sa yamunātīre dvaipāyana iti smṛtaḥ |
atha rāmahate kṣatre sambhūte viprataḥ punaḥ |
trāṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prāpa sendramaṃśena gāṃ gatam ||
kva sthito bhagavānkaṇvo muniḥ subhrūr mahāyaśāḥ |
phalāni svayamādātuṃ sa niryātaḥ pitā mama |
mama janmakathā pūrvaṃ kathitā muninā yathā ||
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā provāca pṛthivīpatiḥ |
sāpatnye vasudhāvadhvā yogyā rājñaḥ sutā hyasi ||
bheje vivāhaṃ gāndharvaṃ rājā kṛtveti saṃvidam ||
suṣuve sadṛśaṃ putraṃ sā skandamiva pārvatī ||
ayaṃ te tanayo rājanmayi jāto guṇādhikaḥ |
nāhaṃ tvāmeva jānāmi kuto nu tanayaṃ tava ||
