ityāha śukraḥ sādhūnāṃ kopo hi vinayāvadhiḥ ||
tejo laṅghayituṃ śaktaḥ ko nu nāma dvijanmanām ||
kāvyaḥ praṇetā dharmāṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ tadvaco mama ||
atha rājño vacaḥ śrutvā pitaraṃ sā sulocanā |
jagrāha nāhuṣo loke munīnāṃ hi girā sthitiḥ ||
tataḥ prāpa sutau devī devayānī narādhipāt |
yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ ceti kāle kuvalayekṣaṇā ||
sakhyāḥ patiḥ kṣitipate mama tvaṃ dharmataḥ patiḥ |
tacchrutvā bhūpatiḥ prāha dattvā śukraḥ sutāṃ purā |
pūrṇenduvadanāṃ subhru kastvāṃ na bahu manyate ||
na satyaṃ gaṇyate sadbhiḥ satyaṃ sākṣiṣu śasyate ||
druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca kālena prāpadātmajān ||
śaśāpa kupitaḥ kruddho jarājīrṇo bhaveti tam ||
te tamūcurgataprāṇo dhanyo na tu jarārditaḥ |
pūrṇe kāle nijaṃ rājyaṃ yauvanaṃ ca mahīpatiḥ |
iti bruvāṇaṃ taṃ śakraḥ patetyāhoccayā girā |
satāṃ madhye patetyuktaḥ sa surendreṇa pārthivaḥ |
te nṛpaṃ sūryasaṃkāśaṃ patantaṃ taṃ vyalokayan ||
uvāca janmavṛttāntaṃ pātanaṃ ca divo bhuvi ||
divaḥ patantaṃ taṃ ghorā rākṣasā gṛdhragomukhāḥ |
bhuvi puṇyaparo yāti punaḥ svargagatiṃ naraḥ ||
nirvairo nirmamaḥ śāntaḥ prayāti paramaṃ padam ||
yayātiriti dauhitraiḥ pṛṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ nigadya tat |
dānena tapasā kīrtyā satyena kṣamayā tathā ||
nalinaśca taṃsoḥ sūnur duṣyantas tatsuto vibhuḥ |
tatkopādbrahmaṇā śaptaḥ sa papāta tato bhuvi |
jātānasmāñjale kṣiptvā vimuktiṃ ca vidhatsva naḥ |
kiṃ tu tasya nṛpasyaikaḥ putro .stu bhavatā mataḥ ||

column5: iti saṃvidamādāya visṛṣṭā tena sā yayau ||

column3: sa tāmuvāca nājñātāṃ nāvarṇāṃ na parastriyam |
vrajāmīti vrataṃ viddhi mama mānini sarvadā ||
dakṣiṇāṅkopaviṣṭā ca tvaṃ snuṣā me bhaviṣyasi |
iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvā tathetyuktvā trimārgagā |
taṃ yuvānaṃ tataḥ prāha sa kadācitsutaṃ nṛpaḥ |
gaṅgākūle purā putra divyā yoṣitsvayaṃ mayā ||
vṛtā snuṣeti vacasā tāṃ bhajasva samāgatām |
pituḥ smṛtvā vacaḥ prāha rambhoru bhaja māmiti ||
jaghāna salile kṣiptvā noce kiṃcicca tāṃ nṛpaḥ ||
vasubhāryā niśamyeti taṃ prāha dayitaṃ priyā |
tejasā saha naśyanti strījitānāṃ hi buddhayaḥ ||
martyeṣu janma bhūyādvaḥ śāpaṃ śrutveti te tataḥ |
yo hartā dyaurastu ciraṃ manuṣyo .yaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
iti śaptāvaśiṣṭena mocitāḥ sapta te mayā |
ityuktvā prayayau gaṅgā tūrṇamādāya taṃ śiśum |
jāhnavī taṃ narapateḥ punaretya sutaṃ dadau ||
kāsīti pṛṣṭā sā tena provāca varavarṇinī |
tataḥ smareṇa sahasā sa dhīro vivaśīkṛtaḥ |
asyāṃ jāto rājyabhāgī sutaste yadi bhūpate |
sutena pṛṣṭaḥ provāca tvamevaikaḥ suto mama |
kathaṃ tvayi sthite vīra dauhitro me nṛpo bhavet |
nāhaṃ rājyaṃ kariṣyāmi satyo .yaṃ samayo mama |
tvatsutānāṃ tu vīrāṇāṃ rājyaṃ ko vārayiṣyati ||
bhīṣaṇā te pratijñeyaṃ bhīṣmeti procire surāḥ ||
svacchandanidhanaṃ tasmai dadau tuṣṭaḥ pitā varam |
āpatsvapi na sīdanti satāṃ satprakriyāḥ kriyāḥ ||
sādhūnāṃ maraṇaṃ śreyo na mātaḥ satyaviplavaḥ ||
tyajanti jīvitaṃ kāle maryādāṃ na tu māninaḥ ||
bhīṣmasyeti vacaḥ śrutvā prāha satyavatī śanaiḥ |
vedavyāsaṃ mahātmānaṃ taṃ smarāmi kulasya naḥ |
sasmāra tapaso rāśiṃ sā sutaṃ jñānabhāskaram ||
saṃgamya taṃ munivaraṃ bhītā netre nyamīlayat ||
iti pṛṣṭo muniḥ prāha tanayo .syāṃ bhaviṣyati |
dharmo māṇḍavyaśāpena sa bālaḥ śūdratāṃ gataḥ |
maunavrataḥ sa taiḥ pṛṣṭo yadā novāca kiṃcana |
tadā taṃ caurasahitaṃ te ninyuḥ pārthivāntikam ||
śūlasthaḥ sa tapastīvraṃ ciraṃ tepe mahātapāḥ ||
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa taṃ jñātvā cakito nṛpaḥ ||
ākṛṣyamāṇaṃ śūlāgraṃ yadā tasya na niryayau |
pucche yatputtikā pūrvaṃ tvayā viddhā tṛṇāṅkuraiḥ ||
mayā bālye kṛtaṃ hyetadbālā yasmād apātakāḥ |
evaṃ munīndraśāpena dharmo yātaḥ sa śūdratām |
viditvāndhaṃ patiṃ sā tu satī vrataparāyaṇā |
putrī ca mātuleyī ca gṛhe sā tasya kanyakā |
tvayā saha kuraṅgākṣi saṃgamo me prasādanam |
ityarthitā sā bahuśo raviṇā saṃgamaṃ yayau ||
prītyā ratyā ca sahito manobhava ivābabhau ||
sa jitvā dikṣu bhūpālānkaraṃ prāpya dhanurdharaḥ |
tyaktvā rājyaṃ vane tasthau brahmacārī vadhūsakhaḥ |
iti patyurvacaḥ śrutvā kuntī prāha sulocanā ||
na cintayāmi putro me tvatta eva bhaviṣyati ||
column5: tvayā me sadṛśaḥ putro na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||

column3: vyuṣitāśvaḥ purā rājā pauravo yajvanāṃ varaḥ |
taṃ vyasuṃ rājamahiṣī bhadrā nāma manaḥpriyam |
rājño vicitravīryasya vayaṃ ca kṣetrajāḥ sutāḥ |
ityākarṇya vaco bhartuḥ prāha kuntī natānanā |
sāhaṃ kaṃ devam āhvāya tvadājñākāriṇī vibho |
iti rājñyā vacaḥ śrutvā prahṛṣṭaḥ pāṇḍurabravīt |
tasmin eva sa kaunteyo bhīmakarmā vṛkodaraḥ ||
tataḥ pāṇḍuḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā smṛtvā śakraṃ divaukasām |
putraṃ hi tejasāṃ rāśiṃ devaṃ sūryamivāditiḥ ||
tato bhartrārthitā kuntī mādrī mantraṃ dadau rahaḥ |
suṣuve yamajau kāle tato mādrī tayoḥ sutau |
roddhuṃ śaśāka na manaḥ prasṛtaṃ priyasya ko vā vidhātṛcaritaṃ parimārṣṭumīśaḥ ||
unmādinīṃ sapadi madranarendraputrīṃ kelīpalāśaśayanaṃ vijane nināya ||
svaputranirviśeṣau tu pālyau me tanayau tvayā |
vijane jananīṃ prāha satyāṃ satyanidhiḥ svayam ||
na bhāti bhūḥ saṃkucitā padminīva himāhatā ||
iti vyāsavacaḥ śrutvā gatvā satyavatī vanam |
cicheda tadruṣā tasmai viṣānnaṃ kauravo dadau ||
gṛhītau tau kṛpārdreṇa rājñā śantanunā vanāt ||

column89: rājovāca |

column3: kṛpaḥ kṛpī ca tau nāmnā loke khyātau babhūvatuḥ ||
sa prāpa gautamīṃ bhāryāṃ kṛpasya bhaginīṃ kṛpīm |
tatsmṛtvā prāpya taṃ droṇo vayasyaṃ pārṣataṃ nṛpam |
taṃ prāha drupado brahmanmūrkho .si bata mandadhīḥ |
na lajjase kathaṃ rājā tava bhikṣābhujaḥ sakhā ||
te tasya dṛṣṭvā tatkarma bhīṣmāyaitya nyavedayan |
tamāha tvatsamaḥ śiṣyo nānyo mama bhaviṣyati ||
dadau ca taṃ nikṛtyāsmai nirvikārānano .tha saḥ ||
pratiyāte tato droṇe yāti kāle dhanurbhṛtām |
te prāhurbhāsamakhilaṃ paśyāmaḥ svaṃ ca kārmukam |
tataḥ pārthaṃ pariṣvajya śaraṃ muñceti sādaram |
samaiḥ sakhyaṃ ca yuddhaṃ ca bhāratānāṃ kulavratam ||
tato duryodhanaḥ prāha guro yuktaṃ na bhāṣase |
aho nu citraṃ rādheya spardhase savyasācinā ||
gūḍhaṃ hi mahatāṃ janma paricchettuṃ ka īśvaraḥ ||
pārtha yūyaṃ yathā jātāḥ kiṃ tena kathitena vā |
prāptarājyo mayā gatvā saralena sa yācitaḥ ||
na tulyo .sīti me cakre nyakkāraṃ madaviplutaḥ |
sakhyaṃ punaḥ samādāya bhāradvājo mumoca tam |
sa hi droṇāya rājyārdham āhicchatrapuraṃ dadau ||
vinirjito raṇe rājā matvā droṇaṃ sudurjayam |
babhūva viduro gūḍhaṃ tāndhiyaiva rarakṣa ca ||
na pauruṣeṇa na tyāgānna nītyā vā pṛthāsutāḥ |
lokasya priyatāṃ yātāste puṇyaiḥ kiṃ tu kevalaiḥ ||
te vayaṃ tava dāyādā māninaḥ pṛthivīpateḥ |
na sahante prakṛtayaḥ pārthadrohaṃ na bāndhavāḥ ||
visṛjya svāṃ śriyaṃ kartuṃ baddhamūlāṃ tvamarhasi ||
bhavitavyatayā hanta buddhiḥ kasya na kṛṣyate ||
bhoktumicchāmyupāyena tvaṃ hi me prathamā gatiḥ ||
yaḥ kāyakartanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vetti śastram alohajam |
śiśirapratipakṣaṃ ca kakṣaghnaṃ na sa hanyate ||
tatra taiḥ pūjitāḥ pauraiḥ pūjayanto dvijottamān |
idaṃ mandiramāgneyaṃ śaṅke naḥ śatrubhiḥ kṛtam ||
kiṃ na dagdhā vayaṃ sarve dagdhapāṇḍavadarśinaḥ |
diṣṭyā ca sānubandho .sau svayaṃ dagdhaḥ prarocanaḥ |
bhīmo gaṅgāṃ samuttīrya viveśa viṣamaṃ vanam ||
jāne cireṇa me diṣṭaṃ dhātrā bhojanamīpsitam |
tamahaṃ māyayā pāpaṃ vañcayāmi bhajasva mām ||
iṅgitajña svayaṃ viddhi mama bhāvaṃ bhavadgatam |
naināmarhasi hantuṃ tvaṃ mayi jīvati rākṣasa ||
prabuddhā sahasā kuntī saha putrairdadarśa tat ||
jahi naktaṃcaraṃ bhīma yāvatsaṃdhyā na dṛśyate ||
sa tena balinā gāḍhaṃ pīḍyamāno niśācaraḥ |
prayayau śaraṇaṃ kuntīṃ bhīmo māṃ bhajatāmiti ||
divā samāgamaḥ kārya iti tāṃ saṃvidābhajat ||
asūta māyināṃ sadyaḥ prasūtiḥ kila rakṣasām ||
tataḥ samāmantrya yayau bhīmaṃ sā kṣaṇadācarī |
āśvāsitā tena kuntī dhṛtiṃ lebhe manasvinī ||
bhikṣānnaṃ te samāhṛtya sadā mātre nyavedayan |
tato .rdhaṃ bhīmasenāya sarvebhyo .rdhaṃ dadau ca sā ||
iti bruvāṇaṃ taṃ bhāryā provāca dhṛtiśālinī |
samayo vihito dhātrā mamāyaṃ nyāyataḥ prabho |
pituḥ saṃtāriṇī kanyā loke hyasminparatra ca ||
dvijaṃ bāṣpākulaṃ kuntī śucaḥ papraccha kāraṇam ||
idaṃ no vihitaṃ dhātrā tatra tvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi ||
vāreṇa bhuṅkte paurāṇāmekaṃ sa puruṣaṃ sadā ||
mastakasthaṃ hi maraṇaṃ prajānāṃ duṣkṛtī nṛpaḥ ||
astu janmāntare mātaḥ svasti vā darśanaṃ punaḥ ||
aho bata nṛśaṃsānāṃ dhuri māṃ cakravartinam |
iti vipravacaḥ śrutvā kuntī provāca sasmitā |
gūḍhaṃ prayātu bhīmaśca yathā na jñāyate paraiḥ ||
kathāḥ pāṇḍusutāḥ svairaṃ papracchuḥ pṛthayā saha ||
drupado nāma sa purā droṇaśiṣyairjito raṇe |
prāptaṃ tadvijito nidrāṃ na lebhe duḥkhito hyaham |
dehi droṇāntakaṃ putraṃ godhanaṃ te dadāmyaham ||
tava rājanniti tataḥ śuśrāva drupado divaḥ ||
droṇaḥ sarvāsu vibudhaṃ taṃ cakre mānināṃ varaḥ ||
iti māturgirā gantuṃ jātodyogeṣu teṣu tu |
vilokya kāntāḥ krodhāndha uvācāgre sthitaṃ jayam ||
aho nu nirbhayā yūyaṃ yadakāṇḍe mahīmimām |
puṇyāmbhasāṃ ca saṃsparśe kālaṃ ko vā parīkṣate ||
taṃ mumoca na vīrāṇāṃ viṣamastheṣu vikramaḥ ||
yo .haṃ citraratho yuddhe tvayā dagdharathaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
gṛhāṇa cākṣuṣīṃ vidyāṃ prāṇadastvaṃ sakhā mama |
evameva na gṛhṇāmi mānī tvaṃ kṣatriyo yadi |
ityuktvā sa dadau vidyāṃ pāvakāstraṃ vilokya ca |
sakhyaṃ ca śāśvataṃ bheje jayinā savyasācinā ||
tataḥ kirīṭī gandharvaṃ prītaḥ papraccha nirvṛtam |
śṛṇu pārtha mayā yena yuṣmākaṃ dharṣaṇā kṛtā ||
kāntākaṭākṣahṛṣṭo hi na vetti maraṇaṃ janaḥ ||
iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa pārthena provāca premanirbharaḥ |
babhūva bhārate vaṃśe purā saṃvaraṇo nṛpaḥ ||
bhaja māṃ subhage nītaṃ kāmena tava dāsatām ||
tato mantrigirā rājā vaśiṣṭhaṃ śreyasāṃ nidhim |
śṛṇu prabhāvaṃ vīrasya tasya śāntātmano muneḥ ||
arthināṃ na dadau hotā kāmadhenuṃ mahāmuniḥ ||
smṛtvā tamardharātre ca nijaṃ sūdaṃ samādiśat |
māṃsaṃ kṣaṇena saṃskṛtya dadau viprāya bhojanam ||
śoke bandhuriva snigdhaḥ kuto vā labhyate budhaḥ ||
viveśa jaladhiṃ kaṇṭhe sa baddhvā vipulāṃ śilām |
duḥkhavyathāṃ na jānāti jaḍarāśiḥ kathaṃ tu vā ||
muktaśāpaḥ sa bhūpālo muniṃ prahvo vyajijñapat |
dehi me kṣetrajaṃ putraṃ kule nastvaṃ parāyaṇam ||
sa māturvacasā jñātvā pitaraṃ sānujaṃ hatam |
mā krudhaḥ putra sa pitā pūrṇāyuste divaṃ gataḥ |
svakarmamuddhito lokaḥ ko hantā kaśca hanyate ||
haranto bhārgavadhanaṃ nirdhanā eva te nṛpāḥ |
abhyāse kṣatriyāḥ sarve prasādya brāhmaṇaṃ bhayāt |
ityaurvaḥ krodhajaṃ vahniṃ sa tatyāja mahāmuniḥ |
putra tvamapi kopāgniṃ tyaja mā vikriyā gamaḥ ||
tataḥ sametya kṛpayā pulastyo munibhiḥ saha |
adhṛṣyaṃ kārmukaṃ yatra rādhāyantraṃ ca pārṣataḥ |
savyasācī sa cejjīvedvīro mama sutāṃ paraḥ |
ayaṃ samājo bhavatāṃ kasya no nayanotsavaḥ ||
na naḥ pragalbhate vāṇī yuṣmākaṃ guṇavarṇane |
kṛṣṇāṃ ca tatpaṇaprāpyāṃ dṛṣṭvā yuktaṃ vidhīyatām ||
karṇo vikarṇo nāmnāpi jāyate yasya śātravaḥ ||
ete cānye ca bhūpālāstvadarthaṃ subhru saṃgatāḥ |
arhāḥ kulena kuntyā ca rādhābhettā tu te varaḥ ||
channānāṃ ko hi jānāti tejasaḥ sāraphalgutām ||
vadhyo .yaṃ drupadaḥ kanyāṃ yo .smai dātuṃ samudyataḥ ||
na sehe samare karṇaḥ khalaḥ sādhuguṇāniva ||
yudhyasva kiṃ tavānena na me jīvangamiṣyasi ||
niśi kuntī ca tāvūce samaṃ saṃbhujyatāmiti ||
draupadīṃ ca puro dṛṣṭvā tato bhrājiṣṇubhūṣaṇām |
khinnā vilokya tāṃ kuntī mithaḥ saṃtatiśālinaḥ |
tato yathāgate yāte kṛṣṇe lāṅgalinā saha |
tataḥ sa hṛṣṭo drupadaṃ tamabhyetya samabhyadhāt |
tāta rājendravaṃśyena vṛtā sā bhaginī mama ||
iti putravacaḥ śrutvā drupadaḥ svaṃ purohitam |
rādhāvibhede sāmānyaḥ ko hi nāma pragalbhate ||
anena tatpuro rājñā yantraṃ bhūmau nipātitam ||
muhūrtaṃ harṣaniḥsyandaḥ sthitvā śrutvā ca tatkathām |
diṣṭyā ca yuṣmatsaṃbandhaḥ prāptaḥ sukṛtinā mayā ||
tacchrutvovāca kaunteyo mātuḥ satyāṃ giraṃ smaran ||
putryāstava vayaṃ sarve grahīṣyāmaḥ karaṃ nṛpa |
mā viśaṅkasva dharmasya susūkṣmo hi gatikramaḥ ||
tacchrutvovāca taṃ pārtho mā rājanvimanā bhava |
tadatathyaṃ kathaṃ kartuṃ śaktaḥ satyadhano janaḥ |
tāṃ vilokya sa papraccha vismitaḥ śokakāraṇam ||
aho nu jagatāṃ nāthaṃ mā dṛṣṭvāpi na kampase |
vikalo .pi puraḥ strīṇāṃ nūnaṃ śakrāyate janaḥ ||
spṛṣṭamātraḥ sa ca tayā papāta gatacetanaḥ ||
iti śrutvā tathā kṛtvā sa dadarśa darīgṛhe |
ūcurdharmādayo devāḥ santu no janakā iti ||
tvatprasādādahaṃ deva na patāmi svayaṃ kṣitau ||
evamastviti taṃ devaḥ prītaḥ provāca śaṃkaraḥ |
tejasvī veti te śakrā jātāḥ pāṇḍusutā bhuvi ||
tadarthaṃ sundarī jātā svargastrī saiva bhūtale |
kṛṣṇā tava sutā rājannatra mā vimatiṃ kṛthāḥ ||
etatsarvaṃ yathā vṛttaṃ paśya divyena cakṣuṣā |
ityuktvāsmai dadau vyāsaḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyānamayīṃ dṛśam ||
vismayaṃ ca prakopaṃ ca saṃtāpaṃ ca prapedire ||
uvāca diṣṭyā tvatputraiḥ prāptā kṛṣṇā balāditi ||
kṛṣṇāṃ duryodhanenaiva prāptāṃ mene saha śriyā ||
uvāca putrābhyadhikā diṣṭyā jīvanti te mama ||
cauraṃ dviṣṭaṃ vadhūṃ yātāṃ śatruṃ vitrāsitaṃ kṛtam |
punaḥ saṃgṛhya yaḥ śete sa taireva prabodhyate ||
viśvāsaṃ śaṅkite śatrau mā kṛthāḥ saralāśayaḥ |
śrūyate draupadī teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ mahiṣī matā |
saiva tadbhedanopāyo jīvitaṃ hi kaleḥ striyaḥ ||
ko hi daivaṃ samuddiśya vilambeta vadhe ripoḥ ||
prāptakālaṃ vacaḥ pathyaṃ pramādī na śṛṇoti yaḥ |
dhikchandaṃ sa cireṇaiva naṣṭaśrīkaḥ śṛṇoti saḥ ||
uvāca bata jīvanti nijaiḥ puṇyaiḥ kṣitīśvarāḥ ||
kuravaḥ karṇa darpāndhāḥ sarvajño .tra tvameva ca ||
aho nu nāsti te rājanbheṣajaṃ vyasanāmaye ||
ko hi sarvasvamādāya vītaśaṅkaḥ sukhaṃ vaset ||
nṛśaṃsaḥ śakunisteṣāṃ kuto nu svahite matiḥ ||
uvāca sādhu yuṣmābhiruktaṃ kīrtyai kulasya naḥ ||
yathoktaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa hṛṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ nivedya saḥ |
uddiṣṭaṃ tatra rājyārdhaṃ te prāpya vyavasāyinaḥ |
svayaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraṃ draṣṭum āyayau nārado muniḥ ||
kṛṣṇayā saṃgataṃ bhrātā bhrātaraṃ yo vilokayet |
hriyate godhanaṃ me .dya pārtho rakṣatu māṃ tataḥ ||
apyāyudhārthī saṃsmṛtya pratijñāṃ na viveśa saḥ |
brahmasvavipralopaṃ ca na sehe mānināṃ varaḥ ||
ito me vanavāso .stu dvijopekṣāṃ tu na kṣame |
iti praviśya jagrāha sa niścityāyudhaṃ nijam ||
brāhmaṇāya dadau pārtho godhanaṃ yaśasāṃ nidhiḥ ||
na manyustvayi bhrāturme na cāhaṃ darśitastvayā |
sa gatvā puṇyatīrthāni sevamānaḥ saha dvijaiḥ |
ulūpī nāma sā kāntā nivedyāsmai nijaṃ kulam |
bhajamānaṃ svayaṃ subhru kastvā na bahu manyate ||
rakṣa vā samayaṃ nātha jīvitaṃ vā prayaccha me |
yoṣidvadhe ca satye ca cintyatāṃ gurulāghavam ||
hiraṇyabindostīrthe ca snātvā prācīṃ diśaṃ yayau |
nandāmaparanandāṃ ca kauśikīṃ ca gayāṃ tathā |
dhanyo .smi pārtha yasya tvaṃ svayaṃ saṃbandhamīhase ||
seyamekaiva me jātā kanyāpi tanayo yathā |
asyāḥ suto me bhavitā rājye vaṃśavivardhanaḥ ||

column5: dakṣiṇe sāgarānūpe pañca tīrthāni santi vai |

column3: mātāmahāya taṃ dattvā sa yātaḥ paścimāṃ diśam |
prītiṃ bheje samabhyetya sahasā tena saṃgataḥ ||
tatastau rathinau gatvā dṛṣṭvā raivatakaṃ girim |
teṣāṃ madhye babhau sragvī kirīṭī bhogakuṇḍalaḥ |
ākhaṇḍalabhuvā tena saṃbandhaḥ kasya na priyaḥ ||
preṣyantāṃ draviṇaṃ pūrvaṃ pakṣo .yaṃ pratibhāti me ||
prauḍhā cābhyarthitā tena sā prītimadhikāṃ yayau |
sa pituḥ sarvavidyāsu mātulasya ca saṃgamāt |
sa copasṛtya śanakaiḥ svastivādaṃ vidhāya ca |
tatprītyā guptamindreṇa praveṣṭuṃ nāsti me gatiḥ ||
tataḥ kālena sa prāpya naranārāyaṇau bhuvi ||
sasmāra varuṇaṃ devaṃ sa ca dhyātaḥ samāyayau ||
sudarśanaṃ ca kṛṣṇāya cakraṃ kaumodakīṃ tathā |
somena rājñā vijitaṃ purā yena jagattrayam |
tataḥ pravṛtte bhūtānāṃ medasā vimale tale ||
tamuvāca nabhovāṇī śakra mā sāhasaṃ kṛthāḥ |
takṣakaste suhṛnnātra sthito yuddhena kiṃ vṛthā ||
naranārāyaṇau devau kṛṣṇau te viditau dhruvam |
etau na jetuṃ samare śakyau śakraśatairapi ||
taṃ pārthaḥ śaraṇaṃ yātaṃ rarakṣa karuṇānidhiḥ |
astrāṇi pārtha dāsyāmi kāle te rudradarśinaḥ |
iti hutabhugakāṇḍe prauḍhapārtheṣu pakṣānilabahulavilāsaḥ khāṇḍavaṃ nirdadāha |

column3: muniḥ punātu vo vyāsaḥ sadā saṃnihitā sukhe |
sa pṛṣṭaḥ pṛthuvaṃśena pārthivena kathāṃ hareḥ |
jagāda jagatāṃ hetuṃ praṇamya prayataḥ prabhum ||
tāsu vīryaṃ narākhyāsu yena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
bhītā dudrāva gaurbhūtvā dhanvī tāmādravatsa ca ||
kopaṃ jahi mahīpāla yoṣitaṃ parirakṣa mām ||
vinā dharitrīṃ tiṣṭhanti prajānātha kathaṃ prajāḥ |
na cedvitare lokānāṃ vṛttiṃ putrī ca me bhava ||
ahaṃ vṛttiṃ vidhāsyāmi prajānāṃ tvatsutā satī ||
tataḥ sasyāni pṛthivīṃ svanāmāṅkāṃ dudoha saḥ |
śrūyate munibhirdugdhā tapo brahma ca bhūḥ purā |
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca dogdhāraṃ kṛtvā vatsaṃ ca takṣakam ||
yakṣairapi purā dugdhā vatsaṃ kṛtvā dhaneśvaram |
vṛkṣaiḥ pālāśapātre ca dugdhā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ tataḥ |
teṣāṃ nava navāścānye te te saptarṣayaḥ kramāt ||
rocyo nāma manuḥ ṣaṣṭho bhautyākhyaḥ saptamo manuḥ |
patyuḥ samīpaṃ gaccheti nirastā tena māninā |
kṣamī jyeṣṭho manuḥ sehe tadyamastu na cakṣame |
sā taṃ śaśāpa kupitā caraṇāste patantviti |
pracchannaṃ tatra vaḍavā vane carati śādvalam |
tejasā tena vidadhe tvaṣṭā cakraṃ sudarśanam ||
atha saṃjñā parijñāya saumyaṃ devaṃ divākaram ||
sāṃ madhyamaṃ gale baddhvā vikretuṃ prastutā sutam ||
sa tyāgādvāritaḥ kiṃ me na piteti purohite |
tasya putro hariścandro rājasūye rarāja yaḥ |
mātuḥ sapatnīdattena jātaḥ saha gareṇa yaḥ |
ravetī tasya tanayā sa purā sahitastayā ||
taṃ vilokya mayā piṇḍe kuśeṣveva samarpite |
apṛcchaṃ daivataṃ śrāddhaṃ phalaṃ ca pitṛyājinām |
ta ete pitaraḥ pūjyā devānāṃ tanayā api ||
yeṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ vinā prāhustridaśā niṣphalāḥ kriyāḥ |
menākhyā mānasī teṣāṃ kanyā himagireḥ priyā |
u meti tapaso mātrā vāritābhūdumeti yā |
asūta yā sutaṃ vyāsaṃ gandhakālī parāśarāt |
mānasī kanyakā teṣāṃ pīvarī nāma yoginī |
putrīṃ ca kṛtvā jananīṃ brahmadattasya bhūpateḥ |
teṣāṃ gaurmānasī kanyā yajante brāhmaṇāśca tām |
yajante tānsadā vaiśyā kanyā teṣāṃ ca mānasī ||
sukālā nāma pitaro vaśiṣṭhasya muneḥ sutāḥ ||
rājataṃ rājatāṅkaṃ vā yātaṃ teṣāṃ svadhābhujām |
ta ete pitaraḥ pūjyāḥ krodhahīnāḥ prasādinaḥ |
vāgduṣṭaḥ krodhano hiṃsraḥ piśunaḥ svasṭamaḥ kaviḥ ||
prasthitāḥ pathi gāṃ mūḍhāḥ kṣudhārtā hantumudyayuḥ |
etadākarṇya te sarve taduktaṃ cakrire vidhim ||
janmāntare śrāddhaphalālluptā teṣāṃ na tu smṛtiḥ |
tataḥ kālena te sarve sārasā vyasavo .bhavan |
tasmai vitṝṇāṃ dauhitrīṃ putrīṃ vyāsasutaḥ śukaḥ ||
brahmadatta iti khyātaḥ kāmpilye nagare nṛpaḥ |
sa samāsādya bhūpālaṃ sacivābhyāṃ saha sthitam |
sapta dāśā daśārṇeṣu girau kālāñjane mṛgāḥ |
vayaṃ te .dya kurukṣetre jātā vedavido dvijāḥ |
sacivābhyāṃ saha paraṃ dhāma tacca samāyayau ||
yaḥ karṇena purā vīro digjaye vinipātitaḥ ||
tridivaṃ śantanau yāte hartuṃ satyavatīṃ balāt |
jahāra tarasā so .tha tārāṃ nāma bṛhaspateḥ |
tridaśairbodhyamāno .pi na sa tatyāja tāṃ yadā |
nirvāya sāmnā samaraṃ dadau jāyāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ||
pṛṣṭā tato .yaṃ kasyeti devairnovāca sā yadā |
atha kālena jayino rajeḥ putrā mahaujasaḥ ||
kāle .tha vipule yāte yayātiḥ pravayāḥ sutān ||
tadā rājyaṃ sutasyaiva purordatvā jarāṃ nijām ||
bahuśākhe ca tadvaṃśe jāto krūraḥ sahasradaḥ ||
anādhṛṣṭiḥ kanavako vatsaḥ śyāmo vavṛñja saḥ |
dve bhārye vasudevasya rohiṇī devakī tathā |
cacāra dvādaśa samā brahmacārī paraṃ tapaḥ ||
kaṃsā kaṃsavatī tanvī pālī kahvā ca kanyakāḥ |
ityete bahavo vaṃśā viśrutā yādavā yadoḥ ||
divyaṃ syamantakaṃ nāma prasenaḥ kila labdhavān ||
guhāṃ praviśya gambhīraṃ dadarśa vipulaṃ bilam ||
tatra dhātryā sa śuśrāva vacanaṃ bālasāntvane |
tavaivāsau maṇiḥ putra mā rodīḥ sukumāraka ||
jāmbavantaṃ vijityātha dattāṃ tena sutāṃ hariḥ ||
bimbādharāṃ jāmbavatīṃ lebhe taṃ ca syamantakam |
satyabhāmā svayaṃ gatvā hate pitari duḥkhitā ||
svārthakāle vyatīte hi dhūrtā no kasyacinnijāḥ |
na dvārakāṃ viśāmīti mithilāṃ vimukho yayau ||
kālena yācitaḥ sāmnā kṛṣṇena sa dadau maṇim |
iti pṛṣṭaḥ kṣitibhujā jagāda mudito muniḥ |
vedānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ yena sthityai hastāvalambanam ||
prabhāvaṃ tasya tattvena vaktuṃ ko nu pragalbhate |
dattaṃ tenābhayaṃ teṣāṃ viṣame daityaje bhaye |
petuḥ parasparaṃ teṣāṃ dehe tejasvināṃ prabhāḥ ||
jayastu yudhi daityeṣu vahniḥ śīta ivābhavat |
himasya mahatī śaktiḥ sā kāpi dahanātmikā ||
āsthā kiṃ niścale vāyau kiṃ yamena hataujasā ||
kimete mudritā rudrā vasavo vyasavo nu kim |
na papāta ciraṃ daityo manyustabdha iva sthitaḥ ||
tato varṣasahasreṣu yāteṣu ca kṛte kate |
tvayi deva na jānīmaḥ kartvayaṃ suptasaṃvidā ||
iyaṃ vo vadanacchāyā na śaṃsati parābhavam ||
praśnājñāḥ kiṃtu bhavataḥ pareṇa na vilaṅghyate ||
sahasraśīrṣaḥ śeṣo .yaṃ vaktuṃ jānāti te stutim |
tavaiva bhāratī devī yadi vaiṣā sarasvatī ||
lalanā kva nu nāmāhaṃ kva ceme kulabhūdharāḥ |
tārakāṇāṃ guruḥ somaḥ sadā mama gururbhavān ||
anyeṣu rājavaṃśeṣu bhavantu ca surāḥ pare ||
dānavā bhuvi saṃbhūtā bhavatā ye hatāḥ purā |
chittvā madhuvanaṃ cakre yāṃ purīṃ mathurāṃ purā ||
hayagrīvādayo ye ca daityāḥ pūrvaṃ harāstvayā |
yajñārthe yājñiyāṃ dhenuṃ purā putrasya kaśyapaḥ |
devakī rohiṇī ceti te tasya dayite ubhe ||
dhanyaḥ sa jagatāṃ vandyaḥ kasya vā na spṛhāpadam |
sa mahīmetya mathurāṃ viveśa viṣadāṃ purīm ||
pituḥ svasuste devakyā yo garbho bhavitāṣṭamaḥ |
sānugasya sa te mṛtyurvihitaḥ śaṅkitaiḥ suraiḥ ||
tatra tvaṃ śakrabhaginī bhūtvā pūjyā divaukasām |
jananī vyāpinī kālī pārvatī dharaṇī prabhā ||
atha garbheṣu devakyāḥ ṣaṭsu kaṃsasya śāsanāt |
vidārya jīvitaṃ dehe pāsyāmi tava śauṇitam ||
sa gatvā devakīṃ mūrdhnā praṇipatya prasādya ca |
garbhāḥ kālena te mātaḥ kṣapitā ityabhāṣata ||
vyavardhata vanodbhedaḥ sa gāṅga iva yāmunaḥ |
tataḥ kṛṣṇotsave loke supte niśi niśācarī |
tau dampatī bahiḥ kaṃsabhayānno kaṃsabhayānno kiṃcidūcatuḥ ||
dhartuṃ yadā yaśodā taṃ na śaśāka mahājavam |
pūjyau tau tava putrasya patitāvupari drumau ||
saṃtrāsaṃ ca prasādaṃ ca vismayaṃ ca yayau kramāt ||
vacaḥ śrutvā yayuḥ sarve nandagopamukhā hradam ||
tatra gopagirā jñātvā yāgaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ marutpateḥ |
aho nu hāsyajananī mugdheyaṃ bhavatāṃ matiḥ |
yāgaḥ śakrāya nārhe .yaṃ gopā hi giridaivatāḥ ||
praṇanāma svayaṃ kṛṣṇo gopaiḥ saha giriprabham ||
grastā ivoddhataiḥ kṣipraṃ nādṛśyanta diśo daśa ||
iti dhyātvā dhiyaṃ dhīro nidadhe bhūdhare dṛśam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā khecarāḥ prāhuḥ kimayaṃ girirutthitaḥ |
vipulaṃ viviśuḥ śāntyai nikhilaiḥ saha godhanaiḥ ||
ityuktvā ratnakumbhena mūrdhni tasya dadau payaḥ ||
pālyastvayā sakhā bandhuḥ svasreyo janakasya yaḥ ||
iti praṇayino vācaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śrutvā śacīpateḥ |
mudritā iva tacchaktyā mugdhā no kiṃcidūcire ||
nāyaṃ tava gṛhe mārgo mārgo .yaṃ vijane vane |
tvaṃ na smarasi kiṃ mūḍhe srastaṃ śīlamivāṃśukam ||
kiṃ nu nāma stanau tanvi sotkampau vinigūhase |
aho nu jayinī śaktiḥ samarasya smayakāriṇī |
tataḥ kaṇṭhaṃ nipīḍyāsya dhṛtvā mūrdhni padaṃ javāt |
spardhayā bata lajjante yudhi vajrāyudhena ye ||
tasya kā nāma gaṇanā gaṇanāthe .pi jāyate ||
svarvīkṛtāni śūrāṇāṃ śirāṃsi ca yaśāṃsi ca ||
smayāya durnimittāya nāśāya ca na kasya saḥ ||
na jānīmaḥ sa kiṃ tāvadbhūtamatyadbhutaṃ kṣitau |
kṛṣṇaḥ sa te bhayasthānamityuktvā nārado yayau |
so .yaṃ bandhuḥ kṛtaghno me vasudevaḥ sthito .ntike ||
dhṛtaḥ sarpo nijagṛhe yenāptaḥ satkule kaliḥ |
ataḥ saṃcintyate ḍimbo na tu me gaṇanāspadam |
akrūro madgirā yātu vrajaṃ dānapatiḥ svayam ||
mallābhyāṃ yudhyamānau me raṅge prītatiṃ kariṣyataḥ |
vandhyāḥ kule .pi satataṃ mayanye dhanyatarāḥ striyaḥ ||
na kulaghnaḥ suto yāsāṃ kadācidapi jāyate |
tasyāsya vācyatā keyaṃ yūyaṃ sarve .pi putriṇaḥ |
hitaṃ pathyaṃ ca me mohānna kariṣyasi cedvacaḥ ||
nirjagāma tataḥ kaṃsaḥ parāṅmukha iva śriyaḥ |
hate keśini kaṃsasya priye suhṛdi dānave |
sādhu mādhava niḥśalyaṃ tvāyā kṛtmidaṃ jagat ||
pūjito nandagopena kṛṣṇena ca viveśa saḥ ||
vṛddhaḥ sa sukṛtī tatra putra putravatāṃ varaḥ |
utsaṅge tasya kṛṣṇaṃ ca śītāṃśoriva lāñchanam |
na ca rāmeṇa nitarāṃ kaṃsādāpnoti bhartsanām ||
satyaṃ tatra na gacchāvaḥ paśyāvaḥ kautukātpurīm ||
bhagnaṃ kenāpi mallena śrutvā cāpaṃ nareśvaraḥ |
mayo yogīśvaraḥ so .tha rūpaṃ kṛtvā piturmama |
tataḥ sā vṛttakartavyā śaṅkitā vīkṣya dānavam |
ayaṃ ca mama garbhe .dya tvayā yastanayo dhṛtaḥ ||
suto .haṃ nograsenasya yādavā me na bāndhavāḥ |
rūpaṃ tasya babhau raṅge meghasyeva savidyutaḥ ||
mauṣṭikaṃ nāma vikaṭaṃ tāmarākhyaṃ ca keśavaḥ ||
papāta bhuvi niṣpiṣya mauṣṭikaṃ ca halāyudhaḥ ||
iyaṃ saralatā jātu jātā sārakṣayāya naḥ |
jambukena hatāḥ siṃhā yadi tatkriyate .tra kim |
vadhe tavāpi bhūpāla kathaṃ na kṣubhitaṃ jagat ||
nijaḥ paro vā saṃgrāme naiko .pi nihataḥ puraḥ ||
iyaṃ kṛtakanidrā vā kopaḥ praṇayinīṣu vā ||
panthāḥ pratīkṣyate kṣipraṃ na yatra dayito janaḥ ||
utsaṅge sā śiraḥ kṛtvā putrasya kṣitiśāyinaḥ |
aho nu tvāṃ nṛśaṃsena putra kālena nighnatā |
jñātibhyo duḥsahaṃ puṃsāṃ jāyate nānyato bhayam |
lakṣmīḥ sa tvaṃ hataḥ putra jñātinā jñātivatsalaḥ ||
kasya nāma hate vairaṃ prāṇaiḥ saṃśodhitāgasi |
tyaktvā prayātaḥ sarvasvaṃ nottiṣṭhiti hataḥ punaḥ ||
datvā jalāñjaliṃ cāsya bhavāmi vipine muniḥ ||
sadṛśaṃ tava bhūpāla śrutasya caritasya ca ||
kāle kalitakālāgrā na hi muhyanti dhīdhanāḥ ||
satkriyāṃ bhajatāṃ kaṃso rājyaṃ ca bhajatāṃ bhavān |
rājyārthino na hi vayaṃ na kaṃsastatkṛte hataḥ ||
tataḥ kaṃsasya rājārhe satkārye bandhubhiḥ kṛte |
gatvā jalanidhiṃ ghoraṃ mamajja mahasāṃ nidhiḥ ||
iha pañcajano nāma daityo vasati duḥsahaḥ |
avāpa pāñcajanyākhyaṃ śaṅkhaṃ na tu guroḥ sutam ||
kaliṅgaḥ kauśikaḥ pauṇḍraḥ krātho rukmī sabhīṣmakaḥ |
yadā tadā ruṣā rāmaḥ samutthāyādahe halam ||
tataḥ prāptaḥ sa mathurāṃ pūjitaḥ kāliyadviṣā |
jarāsaṃdhena sahitā ye na jeyāḥ surairapi ||
krameṇa vinipātānāṃ bhayaṃ te mahatāṃ dviṣām |
kṛṣṇasarpaḥ tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kumbhe prakṣipya mudrite |
śrānto nidrāṃ varātprāpya vidadhe saṃvidaṃ suraiḥ |
na cakāra matiṃ rājye virase vigataspṛhaḥ ||
jīrṇe jagati vicchāye sajane kā ratiḥ satām ||
tasyāṃ porajanaṃ sarvaṃ śaṅkho nāma nidhīśvaraḥ |
śuśrāva rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣmaḥ kanyāṃ rūpema viśrutām ||
vīro bibharti yaḥ spardhāṃ bhuvi bhārgavabhīṣmayoḥ ||
anujāṃ rukmiṇīṃ dṛptaḥ sa kṛṣmenārthitāṃ sadā |
iyaṃ kṛṣṇena kṛṣṇena kanyā kanyā hṛtā hṛtā |
atrāntare puro rājñāṃ skmī krodhāgninā jvalan |
kuṇḍinākhyaṃ puraṃ rukmī praviveśa na lajjayā ||
anyā jagatpatiḥ patnīrmūrtā iva diśo daśa ||
kālindī satyabhāmā ca satyā jāmbavatī tathā |
śyāmāḥ śyāmā iva prītyā bhejire śeṣaśāyinam ||
ityukto halinā rukmī na kiṃcitpratyuvāca tam ||
tacchrutvā na jito .smīti vādinaṃ punareva tam |
sāmbo nāma kadācittu jāmbavatyāṃ hareḥ sutaḥ |
duryodhanaḥ svaṃya gatvā praṇipatya prasādya ca |
sāmbaṃ muktvā gadāyuddhe prayayau tasya śiṣyatām ||
yudhi sehe na taṃ kaścitpravṛddhaṃ lokakaṇṭakam ||
jaganti jagatāṃ nātha narako nāma bhūmijaḥ |
bādhate kāmagaṃ yasya puraṃ prāgjyotiṣaṃ divi ||
kṣapayantyakṣayā bhāṃsi mahāṃsi ca yaśāṃsi naḥ ||
nākaṃ nākapatau yāte hariḥ prāgjyotiṣaṃ puram |
hayagrīvaṃ ca yo varṣasahasraṃ yuyudhe suraiḥ |
cakre cakreṇa narakaṃ dvidhā cakrāyudhaḥ krudhā ||
putraśokākulā devī chatraṃ ca pradadau mahī |
sa dṛṣṭvā divi deveśaṃ pūjitastena sādaram |
taṃ kālaśambaraṃ ghoraṃ sābhilāṣāṃ ca tadvadhūm |
sa babhūva paraṃ vīraḥ kārṣṇilokeṣu viśrutaḥ |
dhanyāsīti mayā sāpi pṛṣṭā māṃ pratyabhāṣata ||
pṛṣṭaḥ so .pi mayā prāha mattaḥ kṣitiriyaṃ varā ||
brūhi kiṃ te bhayamiti brāhmaṇaḥ śauriṇoditaḥ |
hṛtāḥ kenāpi bhūtena caturthaṃ parirakṣa me |
avicchinnaṃ jagadvyāpi dṛṣṭvā tyaktvā ca taṃ ratham |
jahāra surasaṃghānāṃ tejāṃsi ca yaśāṃsi ca ||
āsthāne yasya sa gaṇaḥ sabhyatāṃ satataṃ yayau ||
iti vādini kumbhāṇḍe bāṇe ca samarotsuke |
tāṃ vīkṣya sādarāṃ devī babhāṣe lalitānanām |
vaiśākhe harmyasaktāyā dvādaśyāṃ niśi yena te |
bhavitā saṃgamaḥ svapne sa te prāgjātivallabhaḥ ||
ityuṣā sahasā sakhyā pṛṣṭā tāṃ pratyabhāṣata ||
kathaṃ nu dūṣitā nāma pūjyāsi janamāninī ||
kiṃ na smarasi yadgauryā sūcitaṃ kelikānane |
na jānīmaḥ sa kaḥ kvāste kathaṃ vā kena labhyate |
darśayāmi tava kṣipraṃ tato jānīhi vallabham ||
prasahyāpahṛtaṃ yena dhairyaṃ me manasā saha ||
yadi ter.tho mama prāṇairyadi te .haṃ priyā sakhī |
tadanena kuru kṣipraṃ kāntena mama saṃgamam ||
tataḥ sakhi kathaṃ nāma vīraṃ te jīviteśvaram |
kārye priyasakhīprītyā premṇi vā kiṃ vicintyate ||
iti dhyātvā muhurvīrā sā tamovidyayā puraḥ |
kiṃ karomīti saṃbhrāntā kampamānā lateva sā ||
aniruddho .pi tāṃ prāpya vallabhāṃ bhuvi durlabhām |
vacobhiriti vīrāṇāṃ te bāṇasya ca śāsanāt |
ādāya tatsamutsṛṣṭaṃ khaḍgaṃ carma ca bhāsvaram |
maṇḍalāni caranvīraḥ sa cakarta raṇe ripūn ||
bāṇasya bhittvā sā dehaṃ viveśa dharaṇītalam |
aho bata vimoho vaḥ pratipakṣaḥ parākrame |
manye muhyati yāṃ dṛṣṭvā smaro .pi smarapīḍitaḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā ca durjayaṃ yuddhe babandha phaṇimaṇḍalaiḥ ||
gantavyaṃ bhavatā yoddhuṃ sāmasādhyā na dānavāḥ ||
durgasaṃtāriṇīṃ durgāṃ tadā sa śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
kṣapitāḥ pakṣirājena kṣaṇaṃ śarma na lebhire ||
so .bravītkṛṣṇa kṛṣṇāhaṃ pradīpto na labhe dhṛtim |
sa tena samare ghore samākrāntaḥ krudhā jvalan |
nipīḍya nibiḍaṃ dorbhiḥ kṣitau kṣipattaḥ sa śauriṇā |
mādhavena tu tadvākyātsaṃhṛte ca nije jvare |
kiṃ te priyaṃ karomīti vādinaṃ hṛṣṭamānasam |
ye manmayāḥ saṃsmaranti santu te vijvarā narāḥ ||
ityuktaḥ śauriṇā prītyā tathetyāha hari jvaraḥ |
jitastvāyā dānavakānanāgre prasahya yuddhe tava kiṃ karomi ||
mānino daityasubhaṭā na tasthurna yayuḥ kṣaṇam ||
nadīvegā iva gatāḥ pratīpaṃ na samāyayuḥ ||
vikrīya kiṃ gatā yūyaṃ mṛtyuḥ sarvatra dehinām ||
iti bāṇena bahuśaḥ kumbhāṇḍena ca māninā |
nivāryamāṇā api te jagmureva diśo daśa ||
harirālokya niṣkampaḥ sajjaṃ cakre nijaṃ dhanuḥ ||
jṛmbhite bhairave bhīmaṃ bhayaṃ bhūtāni lebhire ||
guhaṃ vīkṣya kaṭākṣeṇa tadvadhe vidadhe matim ||
aho bata na jānīmaḥ kiyatī bhavitavyatā |
tā madarthaṃ tvayā deva hartavyā iti sasmitaḥ ||
kṣantumarhasi me deva jahi kopaṃ tamomayam ||
nyāsīkṛtaṃ godhanaṃ ca bāṇena parirakṣa me |
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā punaḥ papraccha śaunakaḥ ||
taṃ jāyā mālinī nāma sagarbhānuyayau satī |
sarvasatre nivṛtte tu rakṣite takṣake tathā |
sa kathaṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ bhavatā na nivāritaḥ ||
tatsattramapyaśvamedhaṃ mā kṛthā vighnado hi saḥ ||
iti śrutvā viṣṇṇena muniḥ pṛṣṭo mahībhujā |
tarkaḥ śāstraṃ nāstikatvaṃ ca bodhaḥ śaucācāratyāga evāśu muktiḥ ||
svādu nāśnanti saṃtaptā na ca rātriṣu śerate |
śalyaṃ marmāntare yeṣāṃ gṛhe bhāryā hi dūṣitā ||
viprebhyo mā krudhaḥ patnīṃ mā tyākṣīḥ śuddhamānasām |
mantrātmā veda yajñāṅgaḥ sa varāho mahākṛtiḥ |
vedamātā ca sāvitrī vedaiḥ saha sanātanaiḥ ||
pāyānnaḥ śeṣaśīrṣākramaṇasamuditairvyāptakāyaḥ phaṇāgraiḥ kṣubhyatkṣīrābdhiphenairiva maṇiśabalairmandarābho varāhaḥ ||
yena naḥ sthagitānīva cetāṃsi ca vacāṃsi ca ||
sa evāyaṃ hiraṇyākṣo yena nītaḥ pramāthinā |
kālacakraṃ triśūlaṃ ca kaṅkālaṃ musalaṃ tathā ||
taṃ lāvaṇyamayaṃ vīkṣaaya yayau niścalatāṃ baḍiḥauliḥjh ||
idaṃ te darśanaṃ sādho prīṇāti mama mānasam |
śrotraśuktisudhādhārā vāṇī te kasya na priyā ||
dadāni kiṃ te .bhimataṃ tvādṛśāṃ hi mahātmanām |
ataḥ paraṃ bhavatprītiṃ bahu manye priyaṃvada ||
dayitaṃ bahumānaṃ me yatheṣṭaṃ gṛhyatāṃ mune |
vyāpa padbhyāṃ vasumatīṃ śirasā ca divaṃ kṣaṇāt ||
vaktre smitāṃśucakraṃ ca śanaiḥ śaṅkho .pi vakṣasi ||
iti te caritaṃ puṇyaṃ devasya kamalāpateḥ |
sadyo malinatā vaktre khalānāṃ jāyate yayā ||
ratnodāracatuḥsamudraraśanāṃ bhuktvā bhuvaṃ kauravo bhagnoruḥ patitaḥ sa niṣparijane jīvanvṛkairbhakṣitaḥ |
gaupairviśvajayī jitaḥ sa vijayaḥ kakṣaiḥ kṣitā vṛṣṇayastasmātsarvamidaṃ vicārya suciraṃ śāntyai mano dīyatām ||
yāḥ kurvanti śaśāṅkabimbaviṣade lakṣmīmukhābje muhuḥ kastūrīrasapattrabhaṅgasubhagā lakṣmīmukhābje muhaḥ
